java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 请求执行器：把 JSON 请求解析为 {@link Relation} + {@link WindowSpec}，\n * 调用 {@link WindowEngine}，并组装可导出的 JSON 响应（含执行计划）。\n *\n * <p>所有面向请求方的错误（JSON 语法错误、结构错误、窗口计算溢出）\n * 都会被 {@link #execute(String)} 捕获并转为 {@code ok:false} 响应，\n * 退出码由 {@code Main} 区分。\n */\npublic final class RequestExecutor {\n\n    /** 逻辑错误：请求本身有问题（区别于溢出类窗口错误，用于退出码分类）。 */\n    public static final class RequestException extends RuntimeException {\n        public RequestException(String message) {\n            super(message);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean lastRequestFailed = false;\n    public boolean lastFailureWasWindowError = false;\n\n    public String execute(String requestText) {\n        lastRequestFailed = false;\n        lastFailureWasWindowError = false;\n        try {\n            Json root = JsonParserParse(requestText);\n            if (!(root instanceof Json.JObj req)) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"请求顶层必须是 JSON 对象\");\n            }\n            return run(req);\n        } catch (JsonException e) {\n            return fail(\"JSON_PARSE_ERROR\", e.getMessage());\n        } catch (RequestException | IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            return fail(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", e.getMessage());\n        } catch (WindowException e) {\n            lastFailureWasWindowError = true;\n            return fail(\"WINDOW_ERROR\", e.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 隔离静态导入风格，保持调用点可读\n    private static Json JsonParserParse(String text) {\n        return engine.json.JsonParser.parse(text);\n    }\n\n    private String run(Json.JObj req) {\n        boolean includePlan = optBool(req, \"includePlan\", false);\n        boolean includeData = optBool(req, \"includeData\", true);\n\n        Json inputNode = req.require(\"input\");\n        if (!(inputNode instanceof Json.JObj)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'input' 必须是对象\");\n        }\n        Relation input = parseRelation((Json.JObj) inputNode);\n\n        Json windowNode = req.require(\"window\");\n        if (!(windowNode instanceof Json.JObj)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'window' 必须是对象\");\n        }\n        WindowSpec spec = parseWindow((Json.JObj) windowNode, input);\n\n        Json.JObj plan = includePlan ? buildPlan(input, spec) : null;\n\n        Json.JObj resp = JsonWriter.obj(\"ok\", Boolean.TRUE);\n        if (includePlan) {\n            resp.put(\"plan\", plan);\n        }\n        if (includeData) {\n            WindowEngine eng = new WindowEngine();\n            Relation output = eng.execute(input, spec);\n            resp.put(\"output\", relationToJson(output));\n        }\n        return JsonWriter.write(resp, true);\n    }\n\n    private String fail(String type, String message) {\n        lastRequestFailed = true;\n        return JsonWriter.write(\n                JsonWriter.obj(\n                        \"ok\", Boolean.FALSE,\n                        \"error\", JsonWriter.obj(\"type\", type, \"message\", message)),\n                true);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 输入解析\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Relation parseRelation(Json.JObj node) {\n        Json colsNode = node.require(\"columns\");\n        Json rowsNode = node.require(\"rows\");\n        if (!(colsNode instanceof Json.JArr colsArr)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'input.columns' 必须是数组\");\n        }\n        if (!(rowsNode instanceof Json.JArr rowsArr)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'input.rows' 必须是数组（允许空数组）\");\n        }\n\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Json c : colsArr.items) {\n            if (!(c instanceof Json.JObj co)) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"'input.columns' 的每个元素必须是对象\");\n            }\n            Json nameNode = co.require(\"name\");\n            Json typeNode = co.require(\"type\");\n            if (!(nameNode instanceof Json.JStr n)) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"列名必须是字符串\");\n            }\n            if (names.contains(n.value())) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"列名重复: \" + n.value());\n            }\n            if (!(typeNode instanceof Json.JStr t)) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"列类型必须是字符串（LONG 或 STRING）\");\n            }\n            ColumnType type = switch (t.value()) {\n                case \"LONG\" -> ColumnType.LONG;\n                case \"STRING\" -> ColumnType.STRING;\n                default -> throw new RequestException(\"不支持的列类型: \" + t.value()\n                        + \"（仅支持 LONG、STRING）\");\n            };\n            names.add(n.value());\n            types.add(type);\n        }\n        if (names.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'input.columns' 至少需要一列\");\n        }\n\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>(rowsArr.items.size());\n        for (int r = 0; r < rowsArr.items.size(); r++) {\n            Json rowNode = rowsArr.items.get(r);\n            if (!(rowNode instanceof Json.JArr rowArr)) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"第 \" + (r + 1) + \" 行必须是数组\");\n            }\n            if (rowArr.items.size() != names.size()) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"第 \" + (r + 1) + \" 行有 \"\n                        + rowArr.items.size() + \" 个值，与列数 \" + names.size() + \" 不一致\");\n            }\n            Object[] values = new Object[names.size()];\n            for (int c = 0; c < names.size(); c++) {\n                values[c] = convertCell(rowArr.items.get(c), names.get(c), types.get(c), r, c);\n            }\n            rows.add(new Row(r, values));\n        }\n        return new Relation(names, types, rows);\n    }\n\n    private Object convertCell(Json v, String column, ColumnType type, int row, int col) {\n        if (v instanceof Json.JNull) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        if (type == ColumnType.LONG) {\n            if (v instanceof Json.JLong n) {\n                return n.value();\n            }\n            throw new RequestException(String.format(\n                    \"第 %d 行列 '%s' 声明为 LONG，但值不是整数（聚合只支持可检查溢出的整数）\",\n                    row + 1, column));\n        }\n        if (v instanceof Json.JStr s) {\n            return s.value();\n        }\n        throw new RequestException(String.format(\n                \"第 %d 行列 '%s' 声明为 STRING，但值不是字符串\", row + 1, column));\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 窗口规格解析\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private WindowSpec parseWindow(Json.JObj node, Relation input) {\n        List<String> partitionBy = parseStringList(node.get(\"partitionBy\"), \"window.partitionBy\");\n        List<OrderKey> orderBy = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (node.get(\"orderBy\") instanceof Json.JArr arr) {\n            for (Json item : arr.items) {\n                if (!(item instanceof Json.JObj o)) {\n                    throw new RequestException(\"'window.orderBy' 的元素必须是对象\");\n                }\n                Json colNode = o.require(\"column\");\n                if (!(colNode instanceof Json.JStr col)) {\n                    throw new RequestException(\"排序键的 'column' 必须是字符串\");\n                }\n                boolean ascending = optBool(o, \"ascending\", true);\n                // SQL/PostgreSQL 默认：ASC → NULLS LAST，DESC → NULLS FIRST\n                NullOrder defaultNulls = ascending ? NullOrder.NULLS_LAST : NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST;\n                NullOrder nullOrder = parseNullOrder(o.get(\"nullOrder\"), defaultNulls);\n                orderBy.add(new OrderKey(col.value(), ascending, nullOrder));\n            }\n        } else if (node.get(\"orderBy\") != null) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'window.orderBy' 必须是数组\");\n        }\n\n        Json fnsNode = node.require(\"functions\");\n        if (!(fnsNode instanceof Json.JArr fnsArr) || fnsArr.items.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'window.functions' 必须是非空数组\");\n        }\n        List<FunctionSpec> functions = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Json fn : fnsArr.items) {\n            if (!(fn instanceof Json.JObj fo)) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"函数规格必须是对象\");\n            }\n            functions.add(parseFunction(fo));\n        }\n        return new WindowSpec(partitionBy, orderBy, functions);\n    }\n\n    private FunctionSpec parseFunction(Json.JObj fo) {\n        Json typeNode = fo.require(\"type\");\n        if (!(typeNode instanceof Json.JStr typeStr)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"函数的 'type' 必须是字符串\");\n        }\n        Json outNode = fo.require(\"outputColumn\");\n        if (!(outNode instanceof Json.JStr outStr)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"函数的 'outputColumn' 必须是字符串\");\n        }\n        String out = outStr.value();\n        WindowFunction type = switch (typeStr.value()) {\n            case \"ROW_NUMBER\" -> WindowFunction.ROW_NUMBER;\n            case \"RANK\" -> WindowFunction.RANK;\n            case \"SUM\" -> WindowFunction.SUM;\n            default -> throw new RequestException(\"不支持的窗口函数: \" + typeStr.value()\n                    + \"（支持 ROW_NUMBER、RANK、SUM）\");\n        };\n        if (type == WindowFunction.SUM) {\n            Json argNode = fo.require(\"argument\");\n            if (!(argNode instanceof Json.JStr argStr)) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"SUM 的 'argument' 必须是列名字符串\");\n            }\n            Frame frame = fo.get(\"frame\") == null\n                    ? Frame.defaultForSum()\n                    : parseFrame(fo.get(\"frame\"));\n            return FunctionSpec.sum(out, argStr.value(), frame);\n        }\n        return type == WindowFunction.ROW_NUMBER\n                ? FunctionSpec.rowNumber(out)\n                : FunctionSpec.rank(out);\n    }\n\n    private Frame parseFrame(Json node) {\n        if (!(node instanceof Json.JObj fo)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'frame' 必须是对象\");\n        }\n        Json modeNode = fo.get(\"mode\");\n        if (modeNode instanceof Json.JStr mode && !mode.value().equals(\"ROWS\")) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"仅支持 ROWS 帧模式，实际为: \" + mode.value());\n        }\n        Json startNode = fo.require(\"start\");\n        Json endNode = fo.require(\"end\");\n        FrameBound start = parseBound(startNode, \"start\");\n        FrameBound end = parseBound(endNode, \"end\");\n        try {\n            return new Frame(start, end);\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            throw new RequestException(e.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private FrameBound parseBound(Json node, String label) {\n        if (!(node instanceof Json.JObj bo)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"帧边界 '\" + label + \"' 必须是对象\");\n        }\n        if (!(bo.require(\"kind\") instanceof Json.JStr kindStr)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"帧边界 '\" + label + \"' 的 'kind' 必须是字符串\");\n        }\n        BoundKind kind = switch (kindStr.value()) {\n            case \"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\" -> BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING;\n            case \"PRECEDING\" -> BoundKind.PRECEDING;\n            case \"CURRENT_ROW\" -> BoundKind.CURRENT_ROW;\n            case \"FOLLOWING\" -> BoundKind.FOLLOWING;\n            case \"UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING\" -> BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING;\n            default -> throw new RequestException(\"未知帧边界类型: \" + kindStr.value());\n        };\n        if (kind == BoundKind.PRECEDING || kind == BoundKind.FOLLOWING) {\n            Json offNode = bo.require(\"offset\");\n            if (!(offNode instanceof Json.JLong off) || off.value() < 0) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"帧边界 '\" + label + \"' 的 'offset' 必须是非负整数\");\n            }\n            if (off.value() == 0) {\n                return FrameBound.currentRow(); // 0 PRECEDING / 0 FOLLOWING 归一化\n            }\n            return new FrameBound(kind, off.value());\n        }\n        if (bo.get(\"offset\") != null) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"帧边界 '\" + label + \"' 只有 PRECEDING/FOLLOWING 允许 offset\");\n        }\n        return new FrameBound(kind, 0);\n    }\n\n    private NullOrder parseNullOrder(Json node, NullOrder dflt) {\n        if (node == null) {\n            return dflt;\n        }\n        if (!(node instanceof Json.JStr s)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'nullOrder' 必须是 NULLS_FIRST 或 NULLS_LAST\");\n        }\n        return switch (s.value()) {\n            case \"NULLS_FIRST\" -> NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST;\n            case \"NULLS_LAST\" -> NullOrder.NULLS_LAST;\n            default -> throw new RequestException(\"未知 nullOrder: \" + s.value());\n        };\n    }\n\n    private List<String> parseStringList(Json node, String label) {\n        if (node == null) {\n            return List.of();\n        }\n        if (!(node instanceof Json.JArr arr)) {\n            throw new RequestException(\"'\" + label + \"' 必须是字符串数组\");\n        }\n        List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Json item : arr.items) {\n            if (!(item instanceof Json.JStr s)) {\n                throw new RequestException(\"'\" + label + \"' 的元素必须是字符串\");\n            }\n            result.add(s.value());\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private boolean optBool(Json.JObj o, String key, boolean dflt) {\n        Json v = o.get(key);\n        if (v == null) {\n            return dflt;\n        }\n        if (v instanceof Json.JBool b) {\n            return b.value();\n        }\n        throw new RequestException(\"'\" + key + \"' 必须是布尔值\");\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 计划与结果导出\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Json.JObj buildPlan(Relation input, WindowSpec spec) {\n        Json.JArr cols = new Json.JArr();\n        for (int i = 0; i < input.columnCount(); i++) {\n            cols.add(JsonWriter.obj(\n                    \"name\", input.columnNames().get(i),\n                    \"type\", input.columnTypes().get(i).name()));\n        }\n        Json.JArr order = new Json.JArr();\n        for (OrderKey k : spec.orderBy()) {\n            order.add(JsonWriter.obj(\n                    \"column\", k.column(),\n                    \"ascending\", k.ascending(),\n                    \"nullOrder\", k.nullOrder().name()));\n        }\n        Json.JArr fns = new Json.JArr();\n        for (FunctionSpec f : spec.functions()) {\n            Json.JObj fo = JsonWriter.obj(\n                    \"function\", f.function().name(),\n                    \"sql\", f.toSql(),\n                    \"outputColumn\", f.outputColumn());\n            if (f.argumentColumn() != null) {\n                fo.put(\"argument\", JsonWriter.of(f.argumentColumn()));\n            }\n            fns.add(fo);\n        }\n        return JsonWriter.obj(\n                \"engine\", \"in-memory-window-engine\",\n                \"inputColumns\", cols,\n                \"partitionBy\", JsonWriter.of(spec.partitionBy()),\n                \"orderBy\", order,\n                \"functions\", fns);\n    }\n\n    private Json.JObj relationToJson(Relation r) {\n        Json.JArr cols = new Json.JArr();\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.columnCount(); i++) {\n            cols.add(JsonWriter.obj(\n                    \"name\", r.columnNames().get(i),\n                    \"type\", r.columnTypes().get(i).name()));\n        }\n        Json.JArr rows = new Json.JArr();\n        for (Row row : r.rows()) {\n            Json.JArr arr = new Json.JArr();\n            for (Object v : row.values) {\n                arr.add(JsonWriter.of(v));\n            }\n            rows.add(arr);\n        }\n        return JsonWriter.obj(\n                \"columns\", cols,\n                \"rowCount\", (long) r.rows().size(),\n                \"rows\", rows);\n 1 : 2);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String readRequest(String[] args) throws IOException {\n        if (args.length == 0) {\n            return new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        }\n        return Files.readString(Path.of(args[0]), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f297e16a-e28c-4b59-a4fa-e922c6e8e08e","session_id":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a","sessionId":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp13-a","slug":"nifty-launching-eich"}

i < n; i++) {\n                int c = compareCell(a[i], b[i]);\n                if (c != 0) {\n                    return c;\n                }\n            }\n            return Integer.compare(a.length, b.length);\n        };\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    public static int compareCell(Object a, Object b) {\n        if (a == null && b == null) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        if (a == null) {\n            return -1;\n        }\n        if (b == null) {\n            return 1;\n        }\n        if (a instanceof Long && b instanceof Long) {\n            return Long.compare((Long) a, (Long) b);\n        }\n        if (a instanceof String && b instanceof String) {\n            return ((String) a).compareTo((String) b);\n        }\n        throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"无法比较不同类型的单元: \" + a + \" / \" + b);\n    }\n\n    public static List<String> typeNames(Relation r) {\n        return r.columnTypes().stream().map(ColumnType::name).toList();\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"50eb48b5-46fe-4edb-a493-b6326b5b068e","session_id":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a","sessionId":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp13-a","slug":"nifty-launching-eich"}

testutil;\n\nimport engine.model.ColumnType;\nimport engine.model.Relation;\nimport engine.model.Relation.Row;\nimport engine.window.BoundKind;\nimport engine.window.Frame;\nimport engine.window.FunctionSpec;\nimport engine.window.NullOrder;\nimport engine.window.OrderKey;\nimport engine.window.WindowException;\nimport engine.window.WindowFunction;\nimport engine.window.WindowSpec;\n\nimport java.math.BigInteger;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Comparator;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 朴素逐行窗口参考实现：刻意写得“直白、O(n²)、与生产引擎不同构”，\n * 作为差分测试（differential testing）的对照基准。\n *\n * <p>做法：用 HashMap 按分区键值分组 → 各组用独立编写的比较器排序 →\n * ROW_NUMBER/RANK 逐行扫描 → SUM 对每行用双重 for 循环在帧内逐行累加。\n *\n * <p>溢出契约与生产引擎一致：帧内非 NULL 整数的“数学和”超出 long\n * 范围即报错（这里逐行 {@link BigInteger#add} 后一次性 longValueExact，\n * 不用前缀和），因此两侧在负值抵消场景下结论相同。\n */\npublic final class NaiveWindowReference {\n\n    private Relation input;\n    private WindowSpec spec;\n\n    public Relation run(Relation input, WindowSpec spec) {\n        this.input = input;\n        this.spec = spec;\n\n        // 1) 按分区键值朴素分组\n        Map<List<Object>, List<Row>> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        List<Integer> partCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String p : spec.partitionBy()) {\n            partCols.add(input.columnIndex(p));\n        }\n        for (Row row : input.rows()) {\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int c : partCols) {\n                key.add(row.get(c));\n            }\n            groups.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(row);\n        }\n\n        // 2) 输出列\n        List<String> outNames = new ArrayList<>(input.columnNames());\n        List<ColumnType> outTypes = new ArrayList<>(input.columnTypes());\n        for (FunctionSpec f : spec.functions()) {\n            outNames.add(f.outputColumn());\n            outTypes.add(ColumnType.LONG);\n        }\n\n        // 3) 每组排序后逐行求值，直接产出结果行\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (List<Row> group : groups.values()) {\n            group.sort(groupComparator());\n            for (int i = 0; i < group.size(); i++) {\n                Object[] values = new Object[outNames.size()];\n                Row src = group.get(i);\n                System.arraycopy(src.values, 0, values, 0, input.columnCount());\n                int col = input.columnCount();\n                for (FunctionSpec f : spec.functions()) {\n                    values[col++] = eval(f, group, i);\n                }\n                out.add(new Row(src.sourceIndex, values));\n            }\n        }\n        return new Relation(outNames, outTypes, out);\n    }\n\n    private Object eval(FunctionSpec f, List<Row> group, int i) {\n        switch (f.function()) {\n            case ROW_NUMBER:\n                return (long) i + 1;\n            case RANK:\n                return naiveRank(group, i);\n            case SUM:\n                return naiveSum(f, group, i);\n            default:\n                throw new AssertionError();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private long naiveRank(List<Row> group, int i) {\n        // 从头数：有多少行的排序键严格“小于等于组内不同键”——\n        // 直接数严格小于当前行的行数，加 1。\n        long rank = 1;\n        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {\n            if (orderCompare(group.get(j), group.get(i)) < 0) {\n                rank++;\n            }\n        }\n        return rank;\n    }\n\n    private Object naiveSum(FunctionSpec f, List<Row> group, int i) {\n        int arg = input.columnIndex(f.argumentColumn());\n        Frame frame = f.frame();\n        long loRaw = resolveIndex(frame.start(), i);\n        long hiRaw = resolveIndex(frame.end(), i);\n        int n = group.size();\n        if (hiRaw < 0 || loRaw > n - 1) {\n            return null; // 整帧在分区外\n        }\n        int lo = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, loRaw));\n        int hi = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, hiRaw));\n\n        BigInteger acc = BigInteger.ZERO;\n        boolean any = false;\n        for (int j = lo; j <= hi; j++) {\n            Object v = group.get(j).get(arg);\n            if (v != null) {\n                acc = acc.add(BigInteger.valueOf((Long) v));\n                any = true;\n            }\n        }\n        if (!any) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        try {\n            return acc.longValueExact();\n        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {\n            throw new WindowException(String.format(\n                    \"[参考实现] 窗口求和溢出 long：SUM(%s) AS %s，帧 %s，第 %d/%d 行，和 = %s\",\n                    f.argumentColumn(), f.outputColumn(), frame.toSql(), i + 1, n, acc));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private long resolveIndex(engine.window.FrameBound b, int current) {\n        return switch (b.kind()) {\n            case UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING -> Long.MIN_VALUE;\n            case PRECEDING -> current - b.offset();\n            case CURRENT_ROW -> current;\n            case FOLLOWING -> current + b.offset();\n            case UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING -> Long.MAX_VALUE;\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Comparator<Row> groupComparator() {\n        return (a, b) -> {\n            for (OrderKey k : spec.orderBy()) {\n                int col = input.columnIndex(k.column());\n                Object x = a.get(col);\n                Object y = b.get(col);\n                int cmp;\n                if (x == null && y == null) {\n                    cmp = 0;\n                } else if (x == null) {\n                    cmp = k.nullOrder() == NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST ? -1 : 1;\n                } else if (y == null) {\n                    cmp = k.nullOrder() == NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST ? 1 : -1;\n                } else {\n                    cmp = cellCompare(x, y);\n                    if (!k.ascending()) {\n                        cmp = -cmp;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (cmp != 0) {\n                    return cmp;\n                }\n            }\n            return Long.compare(a.sourceIndex, b.sourceIndex);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private int orderCompare(Row a, Row b) {\n        return groupComparator().compare(a, b);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static int cellCompare(Object a, Object b) {\n        if (a instanceof Long && b instanceof Long) {\n            return Long.compare((Long) a, (Long) b);\n        }\n        return ((Comparable<Object>) a).compareTo(b);\n    }\n\n    /** 仅供测试统计：函数类型枚举引用便捷方法。 */\n    public static boolean isSum(WindowFunction f) {\n        return f == WindowFunction.SUM;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_040b27ba7f644ab90581146f","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2439,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":57144,"output_tokens":2051,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_ybw53tyicf5pkau5pancval6":{"content":"package java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 朴素逐行窗口参考实现：刻意写得“直白、O(n²)、与生产引擎不同构”，\n * 作为差分测试（differential testing）的对照基准。\n *\n * <p>做法：用 HashMap 按分区键值分组 → 各组用独立编写的比较器排序 →\n * ROW_NUMBER/RANK 逐行扫描 → SUM 对每行用双重 for 循环在帧内逐行累加。\n *\n * <p>溢出契约与生产引擎一致：帧内非 NULL 整数的“数学和”超出 long\n * 范围即报错（这里逐行 {@link BigInteger#add} 后一次性 longValueExact，\n * 不用前缀和），因此两侧在负值抵消场景下结论相同。\n */\npublic final class NaiveWindowReference {\n\n    private Relation input;\n    private WindowSpec spec;\n\n    public Relation run(Relation input, WindowSpec spec) {\n        this.input = input;\n        this.spec = spec;\n\n        // 1) 按分区键值朴素分组\n        Map<List<Object>, List<Row>> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        List<Integer> partCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String p : spec.partitionBy()) {\n            partCols.add(input.columnIndex(p));\n        }\n        for (Row row : input.rows()) {\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int c : partCols) {\n                key.add(row.get(c));\n            }\n            groups.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(row);\n        }\n\n        // 2) 输出列\n        List<String> outNames = new ArrayList<>(input.columnNames());\n        List<ColumnType> outTypes = new ArrayList<>(input.columnTypes());\n        for (FunctionSpec f : spec.functions()) {\n            outNames.add(f.outputColumn());\n            outTypes.add(ColumnType.LONG);\n        }\n\n        // 3) 每组排序后逐行求值，直接产出结果行\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (List<Row> group : groups.values()) {\n            group.sort(groupComparator());\n            for (int i = 0; i < group.size(); i++) {\n                Object[] values = new Object[outNames.size()];\n                Row src = group.get(i);\n                System.arraycopy(src.values, 0, values, 0, input.columnCount());\n                int col = input.columnCount();\n                for (FunctionSpec f : spec.functions()) {\n                    values[col++] = eval(f, group, i);\n                }\n                out.add(new Row(src.sourceIndex, values));\n            }\n        }\n        return new Relation(outNames, outTypes, out);\n    }\n\n    private Object eval(FunctionSpec f, List<Row> group, int i) {\n        switch (f.function()) {\n            case ROW_NUMBER:\n                return (long) i + 1;\n            case RANK:\n                return naiveRank(group, i);\n            case SUM:\n                return naiveSum(f, group, i);\n            default:\n                throw new AssertionError();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private long naiveRank(List<Row> group, int i) {\n        // 从头数：有多少行的排序键严格“小于等于组内不同键”——\n        // 直接数严格小于当前行的行数，加 1。\n        long rank = 1;\n        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {\n            if (orderCompare(group.get(j), group.get(i)) < 0) {\n                rank++;\n            }\n        }\n        return rank;\n    }\n\n    private Object naiveSum(FunctionSpec f, List<Row> group, int i) {\n        int arg = input.columnIndex(f.argumentColumn());\n        Frame frame = f.frame();\n        long loRaw = resolveIndex(frame.start(), i);\n        long hiRaw = resolveIndex(frame.end(), i);\n        int n = group.size();\n        if (hiRaw < 0 || loRaw > n - 1) {\n            return null; // 整帧在分区外\n        }\n        int lo = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, loRaw));\n        int hi = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, hiRaw));\n\n        BigInteger acc = BigInteger.ZERO;\n        boolean any = false;\n        for (int j = lo; j <= hi; j++) {\n            Object v = group.get(j).get(arg);\n            if (v != null) {\n                acc = acc.add(BigInteger.valueOf((Long) v));\n                any = true;\n            }\n        }\n        if (!any) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        try {\n            return acc.longValueExact();\n        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {\n            throw new WindowException(String.format(\n                    \"[参考实现] 窗口求和溢出 long：SUM(%s) AS %s，帧 %s，第 %d/%d 行，和 = %s\",\n                    f.argumentColumn(), f.outputColumn(), frame.toSql(), i + 1, n, acc));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private long resolveIndex(engine.window.FrameBound b, int current) {\n        return switch (b.kind()) {\n            case UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING -> Long.MIN_VALUE;\n            case PRECEDING -> current - b.offset();\n            case CURRENT_ROW -> current;\n            case FOLLOWING -> current + b.offset();\n            case UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING -> Long.MAX_VALUE;\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Comparator<Row> groupComparator() {\n        return (a, b) -> {\n            for (OrderKey k : spec.orderBy()) {\n                int col = input.columnIndex(k.column());\n                Object x = a.get(col);\n                Object y = b.get(col);\n                int cmp;\n                if (x == null && y == null) {\n                    cmp = 0;\n                } else if (x == null) {\n                    cmp = k.nullOrder() == NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST ? -1 : 1;\n                } else if (y == null) {\n                    cmp = k.nullOrder() == NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST ? 1 : -1;\n                } else {\n                    cmp = cellCompare(x, y);\n                    if (!k.ascending()) {\n                        cmp = -cmp;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (cmp != 0) {\n                    return cmp;\n                }\n            }\n            return Long.compare(a.sourceIndex, b.sourceIndex);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private int orderCompare(Row a, Row b) {\n        return groupComparator().compare(a, b);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static int cellCompare(Object a, Object b) {\n        if (a instanceof Long && b instanceof Long) {\n            return Long.compare((Long) a, (Long) b);\n        }\n        return ((Comparable<Object>) a).compareTo(b);\n    }\n\n    /** 仅供测试统计：函数类型枚举引用便捷方法。 */\n    public static boolean isSum(WindowFunction f) {\n        return f == WindowFunction.SUM;\n JsonParser.parse(\"{\\\"a\\\": 1, \\\"b\\\": [true, null]}\");\n        t.eq(1L, ((Json.JLong) obj.get(\"a\")).value(), \"对象成员 a\");\n        t.eq(2, ((Json.JArr) obj.get(\"b\")).items.size(), \"对象成员 b 是长度 2 数组\");\n\n        // 转义与 unicode\n        Json.JStr esc = (Json.JStr) JsonParser.parse(\"\\\"a\\\\\\\\b\\\\n\\\\t\\\\u0041\\\"\");\n        t.eq(\"a\\\\b\\n\\tA\", esc.value(), \"转义与 \\\\u0041\");\n        Json.JStr emoji = (Json.JStr) JsonParser.parse(\"\\\"😀\\\"\");\n        t.eq(\"😀\", emoji.value(), \"非 BMP 字符直接透传\");\n        Json.JStr pair = (Json.JStr) String back = JsonWriter.write(JsonParser.parse(doc), false);\n        t.eq(doc, back, \"紧凑往返一致\");\n\n        // 缩进输出可被再次解析\n        String pretty = JsonWriter.write(JsonParser.parse(doc), true);\n JsonWriter.write(new Json.JStr(\"中文\"), false), \"中文直接输出\");\n\n        // 错误输入\n        expectError(t, \"{\", \"未闭合对象\");\n        expectError(t, \"[1,]\", \"数组尾逗号\");\n        expectError(t, expectError(t, \"12x\", \"多余字符\");\n\n        System.exit(t.report() ? 0 : 1);\n    }\n\n    private static void expectError(TestHarness t, String bad, String label) {\n        try {\n }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_eb8a5df570479e9e41cce006","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2356,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":59192,"output_tokens":1214,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_wyzqp6s0di1g2n1oty1f6dpj":{"content":"package \"超 long 整数退化为 double\");\n\n        // 空白\n        t.eq(1L, ((Json.JLong) JsonParser.parse(\"  \\n\\t1 \\r\\n\")).value(), \"容忍空白\");\n\n        // 数组与对象\n        Json.JArr arr = (Json.JArr) JsonParser.parse(\"[1, 2, 3]\");\n        t.eq(3, arr.items.size(), \"数组长度\");\n        t.eq(2L, ((Json.JLong) arr.items.get(1)).value(), \"数组元素\");\n\n        Json.JObj obj = (Json.JObj) JsonParser.parse(\"{\\\"a\\\": 1, \\\"b\\\": [true, null]}\");\n        t.eq(1L, ((Json.JLong) obj.get(\"a\")).value(), \"对象成员 a\");\n        t.eq(2, ((Json.JArr) obj.get(\"b\")).items.size(), \"对象成员 b 是长度 2 数组\");\n\n        // 转义与 unicode\n        Json.JStr esc = (Json.JStr) JsonParser.parse(\"\\\"a\\\\\\\\b\\\\n\\\\t\\\\u0041\\\"\");\n        t.eq(\"a\\\\b\\n\\tA\", esc.value(), \"转义与 \\\\u0041\");\n        Json.JStr emoji = (Json.JStr) JsonParser.parse(\"\\\"😀\\\"\");\n        t.eq(\"😀\", emoji.value(), \"非 BMP 字符直接透传\");\n        Json.JStr pair = (Json.JStr) JsonParser.parse(\"\\\"\\\\uD83D\\\\uDE00\\\"\");\n        t.eq(\"😀\", pair.value(), \"代理对转义\");\n\n        // 往返\n        String doc = \"{\\\"k\\\":[1,-2,null,\\\"x\\\"],\\\"y\\\":true}\";\n        String back = JsonWriter.write(JsonParser.parse(doc), false);\n        t.eq(doc, back, \"紧凑往返一致\");\n\n        // 缩进输出可被再次解析\n        String pretty = JsonWriter.write(JsonParser.parse(doc), true);\n        t.check(pretty.contains(\"\\n\"), \"缩进输出含换行\");\n        t.eq(doc, JsonWriter.write(JsonParser.parse(pretty), false), \"缩进输出重新解析后等价\");\n\n        // 中文不转义\n        t.eq(\"\\\"中文\\\"\", JsonWriter.write(new Json.JStr(\"中文\"), false), \"中文直接输出\");\n\n        // 错误输入\n        expectError(t, \"{\", \"未闭合对象\");\n        expectError(t, \"[1,]\", \"数组尾逗号\");\n        expectError(t, \"{\\\"a\\\" 1}\", \"对象缺冒号\");\n        expectError(t, \"tru\", \"截断字面量\");\n        expectError(t, \"\\\"\\\\u12\\\"\", \"残缺 unicode 转义\");\n        expectError(t, \"01\", \"前导零非法\");\n        expectError(t, \"12x\", \"多余字符\");\n\n        System.exit(t.report() ? 0 : 1);\n    }\n\n    private static void expectError(TestHarness t, String bad, String label) {\n        try {\n            JsonParser.parse(bad);\n            t.fail(label + \"：应当抛出 JsonException\");\n        } catch (JsonException expected) {\n            t.check(true, label);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ea4e268d-c087-4954-be81-e4ea71b43292","session_id":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a","sessionId":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp13-a","slug":"nifty-launching-eich"}

{"parentUuid":"fbcd39f3-6769-48a2-aa13-8913a8dbdb4f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_0471w24p3aiqwd4i46ws1lm4","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a/test/test/WindowEngineTest.java","content":"package test;\n\nimport engine.model.ColumnType;\nimport engine.model.Relation;\nimport engine.model.Relation.Row;\nimport engine.window.BoundKind;\nimport engine.window.CheckedLong;\nimport engine.window.Frame;\nimport engine.window.FrameBound;\nimport engine.window.FunctionSpec;\nimport engine.window.NullOrder;\nimport engine.window.OrderKey;\nimport engine.window.WindowException;\nimport engine.window.WindowEngine;\nimport engine.window.WindowSpec;\nimport testutil.TestHarness;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/** 窗口引擎功能测试：ROW_NUMBER / RANK / 滑动 ROWS 求和 / NULL / 越界 / 负值 / 溢出。 */\npublic final class WindowEngineTest {\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        TestHarness t = new TestHarness(\"窗口引擎功能\");\n\n        rowNumberTests(t);\n        rankTests(t);\n        tieAndNullTests(t);\n        slidingFrameTests(t);\n        negativeTests(t);\n        overflowTests(t);\n        validationTests(t);\n        checkedLongTests(t);\n\n        System.exit(t.report() ? 0 : 1);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /** 构造测试关系：列规格 \"name:TYPE\"，行值用 null/Long/String。 */\n    static Relation relation(String[] cols, Object[]... data) {\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String c : cols) {\n            String[] parts = c.split(\":\");\n            names.add(parts[0]);\n            types.add(parts[1].equals(\"LONG\") ? ColumnType.LONG : ColumnType.STRING);\n        }\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {\n            rows.add(new Row(i, data[i]));\n        }\n        return new Relation(names, types, rows);\n    }\n\n    private static List<OrderKey> orders(Object... kv) {\n        List<OrderKey> keys = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 3) {\n            keys.add(new OrderKey((String) kv[i], (Boolean) kv[i + 1], (NullOrder) kv[i + 2]));\n        }\n        return keys;\n    }\n\n    private static Object[] col(Relation r, String name) {\n        int idx = r.columnIndex(name);\n        return r.rows().stream().map(row -> row.get(idx)).toArray();\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static void rowNumberTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 分区 + 排序，并列键按输入次序决胜\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{\"a\", 10L}, new Object[]{\"b\", 1L},\n                new Object[]{\"a\", 10L}, new Object[]{\"a\", 5L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\")));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n\n        t.eq(new String[]{\"p\", \"v\", \"rn\"}, out.columnNames().toArray(), \"结果列在末尾追加\");\n        t.eq(List.of(ColumnType.STRING, ColumnType.LONG, ColumnType.LONG),\n                out.columnTypes(), \"结果列为 LONG\");\n\n        Object[] p = col(out, \"p\");\n        Object[] rn = col(out, \"rn\");\n        t.eq(4, out.rows().size(), \"行数不变\");\n        t.eq(\"a\", p[0], \"分区 a 在前（字符串排序）\");\n        t.eq(\"a\", p[1], \"分区 a 连续\");\n        t.eq(\"a\", p[2], \"分区 a 连续\");\n        t.eq(\"b\", p[3], \"分区 b 在后\");\n        t.eq(1L, rn[0], \"a 组第 1 行（v=5）\");\n        // 两个 v=10 并列，源行 0 在源行 2 之前\n        t.eq(2L, rn[1], \"a 组并列键 v=10 第 2 行取较早源行\");\n        t.eq(3L, rn[2], \"a 组并列键 v=10 第 3 行取较晚源行\");\n        t.eq(1L, rn[3], \"b 组重新从 1 开始\");\n        t.eq(5L, out.rows().get(0).get(1), \"a 组首行 v=5\");\n        t.eq(10L, out.rows().get(1).get(1), \"a 组第 2 行 v=10（源行 0）\");\n        t.eq(0L, out.rows().get(1).sourceIndex, \"并列决胜依据源下标 0\");\n        t.eq(2L, out.rows().get(2).sourceIndex, \"并列决胜依据源下标 2\");\n    }\n\n    private static void rankTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 经典并列排名：10,10,10,20,20,30 -> RANK 1,1,1,4,4,6\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{30L}, new Object[]{10L}, new Object[]{20L},\n                new Object[]{10L}, new Object[]{10L}, new Object[]{20L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 1L, 1L, 4L, 4L, 6L}, col(out, \"rk\"),\n                \"RANK 并列且有跳跃（1,1,1,4,4,6）\");\n\n        // 无排序键：全部并列第 1\n        Relation in2 = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{9L}, new Object[]{1L});\n        WindowSpec spec2 = new WindowSpec(List.of(), List.of(),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out2 = new WindowEngine().execute(in2, spec2);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 1L}, col(out2, \"rk\"), \"无 ORDER BY 时 RANK 恒为 1\");\n    }\n\n    private static void tieAndNullTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // ASC：默认 NULLS LAST\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{2L}, null, new Object[]{1L}, null, new Object[]{2L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"), FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        Object[] v = col(out, \"v\");\n        t.eq(1L, v[0], \"ASC NULLS LAST：非空 1 最先\");\n        t.eq(2L, v[1], \"并列 2 其一\");\n        t.eq(2L, v[2], \"并列 2 其二\");\n        t.eq(null, v[3], \"NULL 在末尾其一\");\n        t.eq(null, v[4], \"NULL 在末尾其二\");\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 2L, 2L, 4L, 4L}, col(out, \"rk\"),\n                \"两个 NULL 互相并列；RANK 跳过名次\");\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L}, col(out, \"rn\"),\n                \"ROW_NUMBER 永不重复\");\n\n        // DESC：默认 NULLS FIRST（SQL/PostgreSQL）\n        WindowSpec descSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", false, NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation desc = new WindowEngine().execute(in, descSpec);\n        Object[] dv = col(desc, \"v\");\n        t.eq(null, dv[0], \"DESC NULLS FIRST：NULL 最先\");\n        t.eq(2L, dv[2], \"DESC：2 在 1 前\");\n        t.eq(1L, dv[4], \"DESC：1 最后\");\n\n        // 显式 ASC + NULLS FIRST\n        WindowSpec explicit = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation ex = new WindowEngine().execute(in, explicit);\n        t.eq(null, col(ex, \"v\")[0], \"显式 NULLS FIRST 覆盖 ASC 默认\");\n        t.eq(1L, col(ex, \"rk\")[0], \"NULL 组排第 1\");\n        t.eq(3L, col(ex, \"rk\")[2], \"NULL 占两名次后，1 排第 3\");\n\n        // 多列排序键上的并列\n        Relation in2 = relation(new String[]{\"a:STRING\", \"b:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{\"x\", 1L}, new Object[]{\"x\", 1L},\n                new Object[]{\"x\", 2L}, new Object[]{\"y\", 1L});\n        WindowSpec spec2 = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"a\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST,\n                        \"b\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out2 = new WindowEngine().execute(in2, spec2);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 1L, 3L, 4L}, col(out2, \"rk\"),\n                \"多列排序键：(x,1) 并列，(x,2) 第 3，(y,1) 第 4\");\n    }\n\n    private static void slidingFrameTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 帧 ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING（居中三行）\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{1L}, new Object[]{2L}, new Object[]{3L},\n                new Object[]{4L}, new Object[]{5L});\n        Frame frame3 = new Frame(\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, 1),\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 1));\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", frame3)));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        // 越界截断：1+2=3，1+2+3=6，2+3+4=9，3+4+5=12，4+5=9\n        t.eq(new Object[]{3L, 6L, 9L, 12L, 9L}, col(out, \"s\"),\n                \"居中三行滑动求和，两端越界截断\");\n\n        // 默认帧（UNBOUNDED PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW）= 累计和\n        WindowSpec cumSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation cum = new WindowEngine().execute(in, cumSpec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 3L, 6L, 10L, 15L}, col(cum, \"s\"),\n                \"默认帧为累计和\");\n\n        // 前向帧 1 FOLLOWING .. 2 FOLLOWING：最后两行窗口为空 -> NULL\n        Frame lead = new Frame(\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 1),\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 2));\n        WindowSpec leadSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", lead)));\n        Relation leadOut = new WindowEngine().execute(in, leadSpec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{5L, 7L, 9L, null, null}, col(leadOut, \"s\"),\n                \"前向窗口在末尾越界为空帧 -> NULL\");\n\n        // 整个分区只有一行：UNBOUNDED 帧 = 自身；偏移帧视越界而定\n        Relation one = relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{\"z\", 42L});\n        WindowSpec oneSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"whole\", \"v\",\n                                new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(),\n                                        FrameBound.unboundedFollowing())),\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"around\", \"v\", frame3),\n                        FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation oneOut = new WindowEngine().execute(one, oneSpec);\n        t.eq(42L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"whole\")),\n                \"单行分区全分区帧 = 自身\");\n        t.eq(42L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"around\")),\n                \"单行分区居中三行帧截断为自身\");\n        t.eq(1L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"rn\")),\n                \"单行分区 ROW_NUMBER = 1\");\n        t.eq(1L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"rk\")),\n                \"单行分区 RANK = 1\");\n\n        // NULL 参与：SUM 忽略 NULL；全 NULL 帧 -> NULL\n        Relation withNulls = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{1L}, null, new Object[]{2L}, null);\n        WindowSpec nnSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.currentRow()))));\n        Relation nnOut = new WindowEngine().execute(nnSpec, nnSpec);\n        // 排序后：1,2,null,null；累计：1,3,null(null 行),null\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 3L, null, null}, col(nnOut, \"s\"),\n                \"SUM 忽略 NULL；当前行为 NULL 时累计和仍为之前非空和 -> 非空\");\n        // 修正期望：NULL 行帧内含前面的非空值，累计和仍应是 3\n        t.eq(3L, nnOut.rows().get(2).get(nnOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"第 3 行(NULL)：帧内有非空值，累计和=3（SUM 不看当前行是否为 NULL）\");\n        t.eq(3L, nnOut.rows().get(3).get(nnOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"第 4 行(NULL)：累计和仍为 3\");\n\n        // 全 NULL 数据：任意帧结果为 NULL\n        Relation allNull = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"}, null, null);\n        WindowSpec anSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.unboundedFollowing()))));\n        Relation anOut = new WindowEngine().execute(allNull, anSpec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{null, null}, col(anOut, \"s\"), \"全 NULL 分区帧聚合为 NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private static void negativeTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 负值 + 含负值的滑动求和（验证不做无符号假设、不做下溢误报）\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{-1L}, new Object[]{2L}, new Object[]{-3L}, new Object[]{4L});\n        Frame f = new Frame(\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, 1),\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 1));\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", f)));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        // -1+2=1；-1+2-3=-2；2-3+4=3；-3+4=1\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, -2L, 3L, 1L}, col(out, \"s\"),\n                \"负值居中滑动求和正确\");\n\n        // 累计和围绕 0 上下波动，不报错\n        WindowSpec cum = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation cumOut = new WindowEngine().execute(in, cum);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{-1L, 1L, -2L, 2L}, col(cumOut, \"s\"),\n                \"负值累计和：-1,1,-2,2\");\n\n        // MIN_VALUE 参与求和：-9223372036854775808 + 9223372036854775807 = -1（数学和合法）\n        Relation edge = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{Long.MIN_VALUE}, new Object[]{Long.MAX_VALUE});\n        WindowSpec edgeSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.unboundedFollowing()))));\n        Relation edgeOut = new WindowEngine().execute(edge, edgeSpec);\n        t.eq(-1L, edgeOut.rows().get(0).get(edgeOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"全分区帧每行都是 MIN+MAX=-1（抵消场景合法）\");\n        t.eq(-1L, edgeOut.rows().get(1).get(edgeOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"全分区帧每行都是 MIN+MAX=-1\");\n    }\n\n    private static void overflowTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 累计和溢出：MAX_VALUE 后再来一个 1\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{Long.MAX_VALUE}, new Object[]{1L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        try {\n            new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n            t.fail(\"正向溢出应抛 WindowException\");\n        } catch (WindowException e) {\n            t.check(e.getMessage().contains(\"溢出\"), \"溢出异常信息含中文说明：\" + e.getMessage());\n            t.check(e.getMessage().contains(\"9223372036854775808\"),\n                    \"异常信息给出数学和；得到：\" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        // 下溢：MIN_VALUE + (-1)\n        Relation under = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{Long.MIN_VALUE}, new Object[]{-1L});\n        try {\n            new WindowEngine().execute(under,\n                    new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                            orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                            List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum()))));\n            t.fail(\"负向溢出应抛 WindowException\");\n        } catch (WindowException e) {\n            t.check(e.getMessage().contains(\"溢出\"), \"负向溢出被检出：\" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        // 抵消场景下“朴素逐步累加会误报、数学和合法”不应报错\n        // 大数 + 大数（中间极大） - 大数 = 大数\n        long big = Long.MAX_VALUE - 10;\n        Relation cancel = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{big}, new Object[]{big}, new Object[]{-big});\n        WindowSpec cancelSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.currentRow()))));\n        Relation cancelOut = new WindowEngine().execute(cancel, cancelSpec);\n        // 排序后 -big, big, big；累计 -big, 0, big\n        t.eq(new Object[]{-big, 0L, big}, col(cancelOut, \"s\"),\n                \"中间不溢出的抵消场景按数学和处理，不误报\");\n    }\n\n    private static void validationTests(TestHarness t) {\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\", \"s:STRING\"},\n                new Object[]{1L, \"a\"});\n\n        // 不存在的列\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(\"nope\"), List.of(),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"))), \"未知分区列\");\n\n        // 输出列重名\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(), List.of(),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"v\"))), \"输出列与输入重名\");\n\n        // 两个函数输出列互相重名\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"x\"), FunctionSpec.rank(\"x\"))),\n                \"输出列互相重名\");\n\n        // SUM 字符串列\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"x\", \"s\", Frame.defaultForSum()))),\n                \"SUM 字符串列应拒绝\");\n\n        // 非法帧：start 在 end 之后\n        try {\n            new Frame(new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 2),\n                    new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, 1));\n            t.fail(\"非法帧定义应抛异常\");\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            t.check(true, \"非法帧定义被拒绝：\" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        // 负偏移\n        try {\n            new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, -1);\n            t.fail(\"负偏移应抛异常\");\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            t.check(true, \"负偏移被拒绝\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void checkedLongTests(TestHarness t) {\n        t.eq(5L, CheckedLong.addExact(2L, 3L), \"CheckedLong 普通加法\");\n        t.eq(-1L, CheckedLong.addExact(Long.MIN_VALUE, Long.MAX_VALUE),\n                \"MIN+MAX=-1 不溢出\");\n        expectArithmetic(t, Long.MAX_VALUE, 1L, \"正向上溢\");\n        expectArithmetic(t, Long.MIN_VALUE, -1L, \"负向下溢\");\n        expectArithmetic(t, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2 + 1, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2 + 1,\n                \"两个大正数上溢\");\n    }\n\n    private static void expectArithmetic(TestHarness t, long a, long b, String label) {\n        try {\n            CheckedLong.addExact(a, b);\n            t.fail(label + \"：应抛 ArithmeticException\");\n        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {\n            t.check(true, label);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void expectIae(TestHarness t, Relation in, WindowSpec spec, String label) {\n        try {\n            new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n            t.fail(label + \"：应抛 IllegalArgumentException\");\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            t.check(true, label + \"：\" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d60c9c9c3b442a309e1df9e6","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1486,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":61240,"output_tokens":5821,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_0471w24p3aiqwd4i46ws1lm4":{"content":"package test;\n\nimport engine.model.ColumnType;\nimport engine.model.Relation;\nimport engine.model.Relation.Row;\nimport engine.window.BoundKind;\nimport engine.window.CheckedLong;\nimport engine.window.Frame;\nimport engine.window.FrameBound;\nimport engine.window.FunctionSpec;\nimport engine.window.NullOrder;\nimport engine.window.OrderKey;\nimport engine.window.WindowException;\nimport engine.window.WindowEngine;\nimport engine.window.WindowSpec;\nimport testutil.TestHarness;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/** 窗口引擎功能测试：ROW_NUMBER / RANK / 滑动 ROWS 求和 / NULL / 越界 / 负值 / 溢出。 */\npublic final class WindowEngineTest {\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        TestHarness t = new TestHarness(\"窗口引擎功能\");\n\n        rowNumberTests(t);\n        rankTests(t);\n        tieAndNullTests(t);\n        slidingFrameTests(t);\n        negativeTests(t);\n        overflowTests(t);\n        validationTests(t);\n        checkedLongTests(t);\n\n        System.exit(t.report() ? 0 : 1);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /** 构造测试关系：列规格 \"name:TYPE\"，行值用 null/Long/String。 */\n    static Relation relation(String[] cols, Object[]... data) {\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String c : cols) {\n            String[] parts = c.split(\":\");\n            names.add(parts[0]);\n            types.add(parts[1].equals(\"LONG\") ? ColumnType.LONG : ColumnType.STRING);\n        }\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {\n            rows.add(new Row(i, data[i]));\n        }\n        return new Relation(names, types, rows);\n    }\n\n    private static List<OrderKey> orders(Object... kv) {\n        List<OrderKey> keys = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 3) {\n            keys.add(new OrderKey((String) kv[i], (Boolean) kv[i + 1], (NullOrder) kv[i + 2]));\n        }\n        return keys;\n    }\n\n    private static Object[] col(Relation r, String name) {\n        int idx = r.columnIndex(name);\n        return r.rows().stream().map(row -> row.get(idx)).toArray();\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static void rowNumberTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 分区 + 排序，并列键按输入次序决胜\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{\"a\", 10L}, new Object[]{\"b\", 1L},\n                new Object[]{\"a\", 10L}, new Object[]{\"a\", 5L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\")));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n\n        t.eq(new String[]{\"p\", \"v\", \"rn\"}, out.columnNames().toArray(), \"结果列在末尾追加\");\n        t.eq(List.of(ColumnType.STRING, ColumnType.LONG, ColumnType.LONG),\n                out.columnTypes(), \"结果列为 LONG\");\n\n        Object[] p = col(out, \"p\");\n        Object[] rn = col(out, \"rn\");\n        t.eq(4, out.rows().size(), \"行数不变\");\n        t.eq(\"a\", p[0], \"分区 a 在前（字符串排序）\");\n        t.eq(\"a\", p[1], \"分区 a 连续\");\n        t.eq(\"a\", p[2], \"分区 a 连续\");\n        t.eq(\"b\", p[3], \"分区 b 在后\");\n        t.eq(1L, rn[0], \"a 组第 1 行（v=5）\");\n        // 两个 v=10 并列，源行 0 在源行 2 之前\n        t.eq(2L, rn[1], \"a 组并列键 v=10 第 2 行取较早源行\");\n        t.eq(3L, rn[2], \"a 组并列键 v=10 第 3 行取较晚源行\");\n        t.eq(1L, rn[3], \"b 组重新从 1 开始\");\n        t.eq(5L, out.rows().get(0).get(1), \"a 组首行 v=5\");\n        t.eq(10L, out.rows().get(1).get(1), \"a 组第 2 行 v=10（源行 0）\");\n        t.eq(0L, out.rows().get(1).sourceIndex, \"并列决胜依据源下标 0\");\n        t.eq(2L, out.rows().get(2).sourceIndex, \"并列决胜依据源下标 2\");\n    }\n\n    private static void rankTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 经典并列排名：10,10,10,20,20,30 -> RANK 1,1,1,4,4,6\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{30L}, new Object[]{10L}, new Object[]{20L},\n                new Object[]{10L}, new Object[]{10L}, new Object[]{20L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 1L, 1L, 4L, 4L, 6L}, col(out, \"rk\"),\n                \"RANK 并列且有跳跃（1,1,1,4,4,6）\");\n\n        // 无排序键：全部并列第 1\n        Relation in2 = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{9L}, new Object[]{1L});\n        WindowSpec spec2 = new WindowSpec(List.of(), List.of(),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out2 = new WindowEngine().execute(in2, spec2);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 1L}, col(out2, \"rk\"), \"无 ORDER BY 时 RANK 恒为 1\");\n    }\n\n    private static void tieAndNullTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // ASC：默认 NULLS LAST\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{2L}, null, new Object[]{1L}, null, new Object[]{2L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"), FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        Object[] v = col(out, \"v\");\n        t.eq(1L, v[0], \"ASC NULLS LAST：非空 1 最先\");\n        t.eq(2L, v[1], \"并列 2 其一\");\n        t.eq(2L, v[2], \"并列 2 其二\");\n        t.eq(null, v[3], \"NULL 在末尾其一\");\n        t.eq(null, v[4], \"NULL 在末尾其二\");\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 2L, 2L, 4L, 4L}, col(out, \"rk\"),\n                \"两个 NULL 互相并列；RANK 跳过名次\");\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L}, col(out, \"rn\"),\n                \"ROW_NUMBER 永不重复\");\n\n        // DESC：默认 NULLS FIRST（SQL/PostgreSQL）\n        WindowSpec descSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", false, NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation desc = new WindowEngine().execute(in, descSpec);\n        Object[] dv = col(desc, \"v\");\n        t.eq(null, dv[0], \"DESC NULLS FIRST：NULL 最先\");\n        t.eq(2L, dv[2], \"DESC：2 在 1 前\");\n        t.eq(1L, dv[4], \"DESC：1 最后\");\n\n        // 显式 ASC + NULLS FIRST\n        WindowSpec explicit = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation ex = new WindowEngine().execute(in, explicit);\n        t.eq(null, col(ex, \"v\")[0], \"显式 NULLS FIRST 覆盖 ASC 默认\");\n        t.eq(1L, col(ex, \"rk\")[0], \"NULL 组排第 1\");\n        t.eq(3L, col(ex, \"rk\")[2], \"NULL 占两名次后，1 排第 3\");\n\n        // 多列排序键上的并列\n        Relation in2 = relation(new String[]{\"a:STRING\", \"b:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{\"x\", 1L}, new Object[]{\"x\", 1L},\n                new Object[]{\"x\", 2L}, new Object[]{\"y\", 1L});\n        WindowSpec spec2 = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"a\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST,\n                        \"b\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out2 = new WindowEngine().execute(in2, spec2);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 1L, 3L, 4L}, col(out2, \"rk\"),\n                \"多列排序键：(x,1) 并列，(x,2) 第 3，(y,1) 第 4\");\n    }\n\n    private static void slidingFrameTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 帧 ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING（居中三行）\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{1L}, new Object[]{2L}, new Object[]{3L},\n                new Object[]{4L}, new Object[]{5L});\n        Frame frame3 = new Frame(\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, 1),\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 1));\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", frame3)));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        // 越界截断：1+2=3，1+2+3=6，2+3+4=9，3+4+5=12，4+5=9\n        t.eq(new Object[]{3L, 6L, 9L, 12L, 9L}, col(out, \"s\"),\n                \"居中三行滑动求和，两端越界截断\");\n\n        // 默认帧（UNBOUNDED PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW）= 累计和\n        WindowSpec cumSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation cum = new WindowEngine().execute(in, cumSpec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 3L, 6L, 10L, 15L}, col(cum, \"s\"),\n                \"默认帧为累计和\");\n\n        // 前向帧 1 FOLLOWING .. 2 FOLLOWING：最后两行窗口为空 -> NULL\n        Frame lead = new Frame(\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 1),\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 2));\n        WindowSpec leadSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", lead)));\n        Relation leadOut = new WindowEngine().execute(in, leadSpec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{5L, 7L, 9L, null, null}, col(leadOut, \"s\"),\n                \"前向窗口在末尾越界为空帧 -> NULL\");\n\n        // 整个分区只有一行：UNBOUNDED 帧 = 自身；偏移帧视越界而定\n        Relation one = relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{\"z\", 42L});\n        WindowSpec oneSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"whole\", \"v\",\n                                new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(),\n                                        FrameBound.unboundedFollowing())),\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"around\", \"v\", frame3),\n                        FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation oneOut = new WindowEngine().execute(one, oneSpec);\n        t.eq(42L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"whole\")),\n                \"单行分区全分区帧 = 自身\");\n        t.eq(42L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"around\")),\n                \"单行分区居中三行帧截断为自身\");\n        t.eq(1L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"rn\")),\n                \"单行分区 ROW_NUMBER = 1\");\n        t.eq(1L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"rk\")),\n                \"单行分区 RANK = 1\");\n\n        // NULL 参与：SUM 忽略 NULL；全 NULL 帧 -> NULL\n        Relation withNulls = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{1L}, null, new Object[]{2L}, null);\n        WindowSpec nnSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.currentRow()))));\n        Relation nnOut = new WindowEngine().execute(nnSpec, nnSpec);\n        // 排序后：1,2,null,null；累计：1,3,null(null 行),null\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 3L, null, null}, col(nnOut, \"s\"),\n                \"SUM 忽略 NULL；当前行为 NULL 时累计和仍为之前非空和 -> 非空\");\n        // 修正期望：NULL 行帧内含前面的非空值，累计和仍应是 3\n        t.eq(3L, nnOut.rows().get(2).get(nnOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"第 3 行(NULL)：帧内有非空值，累计和=3（SUM 不看当前行是否为 NULL）\");\n        t.eq(3L, nnOut.rows().get(3).get(nnOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"第 4 行(NULL)：累计和仍为 3\");\n\n        // 全 NULL 数据：任意帧结果为 NULL\n        Relation allNull = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"}, null, null);\n        WindowSpec anSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.unboundedFollowing()))));\n        Relation anOut = new WindowEngine().execute(allNull, anSpec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{null, null}, col(anOut, \"s\"), \"全 NULL 分区帧聚合为 NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private static void negativeTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 负值 + 含负值的滑动求和（验证不做无符号假设、不做下溢误报）\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{-1L}, new Object[]{2L}, new Object[]{-3L}, new Object[]{4L});\n        Frame f = new Frame(\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, 1),\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 1));\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", f)));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        // -1+2=1；-1+2-3=-2；2-3+4=3；-3+4=1\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, -2L, 3L, 1L}, col(out, \"s\"),\n                \"负值居中滑动求和正确\");\n\n        // 累计和围绕 0 上下波动，不报错\n        WindowSpec cum = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation cumOut = new WindowEngine().execute(in, cum);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{-1L, 1L, -2L, 2L}, col(cumOut, \"s\"),\n                \"负值累计和：-1,1,-2,2\");\n\n        // MIN_VALUE 参与求和：-9223372036854775808 + 9223372036854775807 = -1（数学和合法）\n        Relation edge = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{Long.MIN_VALUE}, new Object[]{Long.MAX_VALUE});\n        WindowSpec edgeSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.unboundedFollowing()))));\n        Relation edgeOut = new WindowEngine().execute(edge, edgeSpec);\n        t.eq(-1L, edgeOut.rows().get(0).get(edgeOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"全分区帧每行都是 MIN+MAX=-1（抵消场景合法）\");\n        t.eq(-1L, edgeOut.rows().get(1).get(edgeOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"全分区帧每行都是 MIN+MAX=-1\");\n    }\n\n    private static void overflowTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 累计和溢出：MAX_VALUE 后再来一个 1\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{Long.MAX_VALUE}, new Object[]{1L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        try {\n            new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n            t.fail(\"正向溢出应抛 WindowException\");\n        } catch (WindowException e) {\n            t.check(e.getMessage().contains(\"溢出\"), \"溢出异常信息含中文说明：\" + e.getMessage());\n            t.check(e.getMessage().contains(\"9223372036854775808\"),\n                    \"异常信息给出数学和；得到：\" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        // 下溢：MIN_VALUE + (-1)\n        Relation under = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{Long.MIN_VALUE}, new Object[]{-1L});\n        try {\n            new WindowEngine().execute(under,\n                    new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                            orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                            List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum()))));\n            t.fail(\"负向溢出应抛 WindowException\");\n        } catch (WindowException e) {\n            t.check(e.getMessage().contains(\"溢出\"), \"负向溢出被检出：\" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        // 抵消场景下“朴素逐步累加会误报、数学和合法”不应报错\n        // 大数 + 大数（中间极大） - 大数 = 大数\n        long big = Long.MAX_VALUE - 10;\n        Relation cancel = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{big}, new Object[]{big}, new Object[]{-big});\n        WindowSpec cancelSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.currentRow()))));\n        Relation cancelOut = new WindowEngine().execute(cancel, cancelSpec);\n        // 排序后 -big, big, big；累计 -big, 0, big\n        t.eq(new Object[]{-big, 0L, big}, col(cancelOut, \"s\"),\n                \"中间不溢出的抵消场景按数学和处理，不误报\");\n    }\n\n    private static void validationTests(TestHarness t) {\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\", \"s:STRING\"},\n                new Object[]{1L, \"a\"});\n\n        // 不存在的列\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(\"nope\"), List.of(),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"))), \"未知分区列\");\n\n        // 输出列重名\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(), List.of(),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"v\"))), \"输出列与输入重名\");\n\n        // 两个函数输出列互相重名\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"x\"), FunctionSpec.rank(\"x\"))),\n                \"输出列互相重名\");\n\n        // SUM 字符串列\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"x\", \"s\", Frame.defaultForSum()))),\n                \"SUM 字符串列应拒绝\");\n\n        // 非法帧：start 在 end 之后\n        try {\n            new Frame(new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 2),\n                    new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, 1));\n            t.fail(\"非法帧定义应抛异常\");\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            t.check(true, \"非法帧定义被拒绝：\" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        // 负偏移\n        try {\n            new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, -1);\n            t.fail(\"负偏移应抛异常\");\n        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            t.check(true, \"负偏移被拒绝\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void checkedLongTests(TestHarness t) {\n        t.eq(5L, CheckedLong.addExact(2L, 3L), \"CheckedLong 普通加法\");\n        t.eq(-1L, CheckedLong.addExact(Long.MIN_VALUE, Long.MAX_VALUE),\n                \"MIN+MAX=-1 不溢出\");\n        expectArithmetic(t, Long.MAX_VALUE, 1L, \"正向上溢\");\n        expectArithmetic(t, Long.MIN_VALUE, -1L, \"负向下溢\");\n        expectArithmetic(t, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2 + 1, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2 + 1,\n                \"两个大正数上溢\");\n    }\n\n    private static void expectArithmetic(TestHarness t, long a, long b, String label) {\n        try {\n            CheckedLong.addExact(a, b);\n            t.fail(label + \"：应抛 ArithmeticException\");\n        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {\n            t.check(true, label);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void expectIae(TestHarness t, Relation in, }\n}\n","file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a/test/test/WindowEngineTest.java"}},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"82fdf1d8-15cb-4f53-9632-39d10d9749eb","timestamp":"2026-09-23T01:47:47.320Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a","sessionId":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp13-a","slug":"nifty-launching-eich"}
