0 : 1);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /** 构造测试关系：列规格 \"name:TYPE\"，行值用 null/Long/String。 */\n    static Relation relation(String[] cols, Object[]... data) {\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String c : cols) {\n            String[] parts = c.split(\":\");\n            names.add(parts[0]);\n            types.add(parts[1].equals(\"LONG\") ? ColumnType.LONG : ColumnType.STRING);\n        }\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {\n            rows.add(new Row(i, data[i]));\n        }\n        return new Relation(names, types, rows);\n    }\n\n    private static List<OrderKey> orders(Object... kv) {\n        List<OrderKey> keys = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < kv.length; i += 3) {\n            keys.add(new OrderKey((String) kv[i], (Boolean) kv[i + 1], (NullOrder) kv[i + 2]));\n        }\n        return keys;\n    }\n\n    private static Object[] col(Relation r, String name) {\n        int idx = r.columnIndex(name);\n        return r.rows().stream().map(row -> row.get(idx)).toArray();\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static void rowNumberTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 分区 + 排序，并列键按输入次序决胜\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{\"a\", 10L}, new Object[]{\"b\", 1L},\n                new Object[]{\"a\", 10L}, new Object[]{\"a\", 5L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\")));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n\n        t.eq(new String[]{\"p\", \"v\", \"rn\"}, out.columnNames().toArray(), \"结果列在末尾追加\");\n        t.eq(List.of(ColumnType.STRING, ColumnType.LONG, ColumnType.LONG),\n                out.columnTypes(), \"结果列为 LONG\");\n\n        Object[] p = col(out, \"p\");\n        Object[] rn = col(out, \"rn\");\n        t.eq(4, out.rows().size(), \"行数不变\");\n        t.eq(\"a\", p[0], \"分区 a 在前（字符串排序）\");\n        t.eq(\"a\", p[1], \"分区 a 连续\");\n        t.eq(\"a\", p[2], \"分区 a 连续\");\n        t.eq(\"b\", p[3], \"分区 b 在后\");\n        t.eq(1L, rn[0], \"a 组第 1 行（v=5）\");\n        // 两个 v=10 并列，源行 0 在源行 2 之前\n        t.eq(2L, rn[1], \"a 组并列键 v=10 第 2 行取较早源行\");\n        t.eq(3L, rn[2], \"a 组并列键 v=10 第 3 行取较晚源行\");\n        t.eq(1L, rn[3], \"b 组重新从 1 开始\");\n        t.eq(5L, out.rows().get(0).get(1), \"a 组首行 v=5\");\n        t.eq(10L, out.rows().get(1).get(1), \"a 组第 2 行 v=10（源行 0）\");\n        t.eq(0L, out.rows().get(1).sourceIndex, \"并列决胜依据源下标 0\");\n        t.eq(2L, out.rows().get(2).sourceIndex, \"并列决胜依据源下标 2\");\n    }\n\n    private static void rankTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 经典并列排名：10,10,10,20,20,30 -> RANK 1,1,1,4,4,6\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{30L}, new Object[]{10L}, new Object[]{20L},\n                new Object[]{10L}, new Object[]{10L}, new Object[]{20L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 1L, 1L, 4L, 4L, 6L}, col(out, \"rk\"),\n                \"RANK 并列且有跳跃（1,1,1,4,4,6）\");\n\n        // 无排序键：全部并列第 1\n        Relation in2 = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{9L}, new Object[]{1L});\n        WindowSpec spec2 = new WindowSpec(List.of(), List.of(),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out2 = new WindowEngine().execute(in2, spec2);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 1L}, col(out2, \"rk\"), \"无 ORDER BY 时 RANK 恒为 1\");\n    }\n\n    private static void tieAndNullTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // ASC：默认 NULLS LAST\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{2L}, null, new Object[]{1L}, null, new Object[]{2L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"), FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        Object[] v = col(out, \"v\");\n        t.eq(1L, v[0], \"ASC NULLS LAST：非空 1 最先\");\n        t.eq(2L, v[1], \"并列 2 其一\");\n        t.eq(2L, v[2], \"并列 2 其二\");\n        t.eq(null, v[3], \"NULL 在末尾其一\");\n        t.eq(null, v[4], \"NULL 在末尾其二\");\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 2L, 2L, 4L, 4L}, col(out, \"rk\"),\n                \"两个 NULL 互相并列；RANK 跳过名次\");\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L}, col(out, \"rn\"),\n                \"ROW_NUMBER 永不重复\");\n\n        // DESC：默认 NULLS FIRST（SQL/PostgreSQL）\n        WindowSpec descSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", false, NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation desc = new WindowEngine().execute(in, descSpec);\n        Object[] dv = col(desc, \"v\");\n        t.eq(null, dv[0], \"DESC NULLS FIRST：NULL 最先\");\n        t.eq(2L, dv[2], \"DESC：2 在 1 前\");\n        t.eq(1L, dv[4], \"DESC：1 最后\");\n\n        // 显式 ASC + NULLS FIRST\n        WindowSpec explicit = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation ex = new WindowEngine().execute(in, explicit);\n        t.eq(null, col(ex, \"v\")[0], \"显式 NULLS FIRST 覆盖 ASC 默认\");\n        t.eq(1L, col(ex, \"rk\")[0], \"NULL 组排第 1\");\n        t.eq(3L, col(ex, \"rk\")[2], \"NULL 占两名次后，1 排第 3\");\n\n        // 多列排序键上的并列\n        Relation in2 = relation(new String[]{\"a:STRING\", \"b:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{\"x\", 1L}, new Object[]{\"x\", 1L},\n                new Object[]{\"x\", 2L}, new Object[]{\"y\", 1L});\n        WindowSpec spec2 = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"a\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST,\n                        \"b\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation out2 = new WindowEngine().execute(in2, spec2);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 1L, 3L, 4L}, col(out2, \"rk\"),\n                \"多列排序键：(x,1) 并列，(x,2) 第 3，(y,1) 第 4\");\n    }\n\n    private static void slidingFrameTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 帧 ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING（居中三行）\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{1L}, new Object[]{2L}, new Object[]{3L},\n                new Object[]{4L}, new Object[]{5L});\n        Frame frame3 = new Frame(\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, 1),\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 1));\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", frame3)));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        // 越界截断：1+2=3，1+2+3=6，2+3+4=9，3+4+5=12，4+5=9\n        t.eq(new Object[]{3L, 6L, 9L, 12L, 9L}, col(out, \"s\"),\n                \"居中三行滑动求和，两端越界截断\");\n\n        // 默认帧（UNBOUNDED PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW）= 累计和\n        WindowSpec cumSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation cum = new WindowEngine().execute(in, cumSpec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 3L, 6L, 10L, 15L}, col(cum, \"s\"),\n                \"默认帧为累计和\");\n\n        // 前向帧 1 FOLLOWING .. 2 FOLLOWING：最后两行窗口为空 -> NULL\n        Frame lead = new Frame(\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 1),\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 2));\n        WindowSpec leadSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", lead)));\n        Relation leadOut = new WindowEngine().execute(in, leadSpec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{5L, 7L, 9L, null, null}, col(leadOut, \"s\"),\n                \"前向窗口在末尾越界为空帧 -> NULL\");\n\n        // 整个分区只有一行：UNBOUNDED 帧 = 自身；偏移帧视越界而定\n        Relation one = relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{\"z\", 42L});\n        WindowSpec oneSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"whole\", \"v\",\n                                new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(),\n                                        FrameBound.unboundedFollowing())),\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"around\", \"v\", frame3),\n                        FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\")));\n        Relation oneOut = new WindowEngine().execute(one, oneSpec);\n        t.eq(42L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"whole\")),\n                \"单行分区全分区帧 = 自身\");\n        t.eq(42L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"around\")),\n                \"单行分区居中三行帧截断为自身\");\n        t.eq(1L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"rn\")),\n                \"单行分区 ROW_NUMBER = 1\");\n        t.eq(1L, oneOut.rows().get(0).get(oneOut.columnIndex(\"rk\")),\n                \"单行分区 RANK = 1\");\n\n        // NULL 参与：SUM 忽略 NULL；全 NULL 帧 -> NULL\n        Relation withNulls = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{1L}, null, new Object[]{2L}, null);\n        WindowSpec nnSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.currentRow()))));\n        Relation nnOut = new WindowEngine().execute(nnSpec, nnSpec);\n        // 排序后：1,2,null,null；累计：1,3,null(null 行),null\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, 3L, null, null}, col(nnOut, \"s\"),\n                \"SUM 忽略 NULL；当前行为 NULL 时累计和仍为之前非空和 -> 非空\");\n        // 修正期望：NULL 行帧内含前面的非空值，累计和仍应是 3\n        t.eq(3L, nnOut.rows().get(2).get(nnOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"第 3 行(NULL)：帧内有非空值，累计和=3（SUM 不看当前行是否为 NULL）\");\n        t.eq(3L, nnOut.rows().get(3).get(nnOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"第 4 行(NULL)：累计和仍为 3\");\n\n        // 全 NULL 数据：任意帧结果为 NULL\n        Relation allNull = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"}, null, null);\n        WindowSpec anSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.unboundedFollowing()))));\n        Relation anOut = new WindowEngine().execute(allNull, anSpec);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{null, null}, col(anOut, \"s\"), \"全 NULL 分区帧聚合为 NULL\");\n    }\n\n    private static void negativeTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 负值 + 含负值的滑动求和（验证不做无符号假设、不做下溢误报）\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{-1L}, new Object[]{2L}, new Object[]{-3L}, new Object[]{4L});\n        Frame f = new Frame(\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, 1),\n                new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 1));\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", f)));\n        Relation out = new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n        // -1+2=1；-1+2-3=-2；2-3+4=3；-3+4=1\n        t.eq(new Object[]{1L, -2L, 3L, 1L}, col(out, \"s\"),\n                \"负值居中滑动求和正确\");\n\n        // 累计和围绕 0 上下波动，不报错\n        WindowSpec cum = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation cumOut = new WindowEngine().execute(in, cum);\n        t.eq(new Object[]{-1L, 1L, -2L, 2L}, col(cumOut, \"s\"),\n                \"负值累计和：-1,1,-2,2\");\n\n        // MIN_VALUE 参与求和：-9223372036854775808 + 9223372036854775807 = -1（数学和合法）\n        Relation edge = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{Long.MIN_VALUE}, new Object[]{Long.MAX_VALUE});\n        WindowSpec edgeSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.unboundedFollowing()))));\n        Relation edgeOut = new WindowEngine().execute(edge, edgeSpec);\n        t.eq(-1L, edgeOut.rows().get(0).get(edgeOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"全分区帧每行都是 MIN+MAX=-1（抵消场景合法）\");\n        t.eq(-1L, edgeOut.rows().get(1).get(edgeOut.columnIndex(\"s\")),\n                \"全分区帧每行都是 MIN+MAX=-1\");\n    }\n\n    private static void overflowTests(TestHarness t) {\n        // 累计和溢出：MAX_VALUE 后再来一个 1\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{Long.MAX_VALUE}, new Object[]{1L});\n        WindowSpec spec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        try {\n            new WindowEngine().execute(in, spec);\n            t.fail(\"正向溢出应抛 WindowException\");\n        } catch (WindowException e) {\n            t.check(e.getMessage().contains(\"溢出\"), \"溢出异常信息含中文说明：\" + e.getMessage());\n            t.check(e.getMessage().contains(\"9223372036854775808\"),\n                    \"异常信息给出数学和；得到：\" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        // 下溢：MIN_VALUE + (-1)\n        Relation under = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{Long.MIN_VALUE}, new Object[]{-1L});\n        try {\n            new WindowEngine().execute(under,\n                    new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                            orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                            List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum()))));\n            t.fail(\"负向溢出应抛 WindowException\");\n        } catch (WindowException e) {\n            t.check(e.getMessage().contains(\"溢出\"), \"负向溢出被检出：\" + e.getMessage());\n        }\n\n        // 抵消场景下“朴素逐步累加会误报、数学和合法”不应报错\n        // 大数 + 大数（中间极大） - 大数 = 大数\n        long big = Long.MAX_VALUE - 10;\n        Relation cancel = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{big}, new Object[]{big}, new Object[]{-big});\n        WindowSpec cancelSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\",\n                        new Frame(FrameBound.unboundedPreceding(), FrameBound.currentRow()))));\n        Relation cancelOut = new WindowEngine().execute(cancel, cancelSpec);\n        // 排序后 -big, big, big；累计 -big, 0, big\n        t.eq(new Object[]{-big, 0L, big}, col(cancelOut, \"s\"),\n                \"中间不溢出的抵消场景按数学和处理，不误报\");\n    }\n\n    private static void validationTests(TestHarness t) {\n        Relation in = relation(new String[]{\"v:LONG\", \"s:STRING\"},\n                new Object[]{1L, \"a\"});\n\n        // 不存在的列\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(\"nope\"), List.of(),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"))), \"未知分区列\");\n\n        // 输出列重名\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(), List.of(),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"v\"))), \"输出列与输入重名\");\n\n        // 两个函数输出列互相重名\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"x\"), FunctionSpec.rank(\"x\"))),\n                \"输出列互相重名\");\n\n        // SUM 字符串列\n        expectIae(t, in, new WindowSpec(List.of(),\n                orders(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.sum(\"x\", \"s\", Frame.defaultForSum()))),\n                \"SUM 字符串列应拒绝\");\n\n        // 非法帧：start 在 end 之后\n        try {\n            new Frame(new FrameBound(BoundKind.FOLLOWING, 2),\n                    new FrameBound(BoundKind.PRECEDING, 1));\n            t.fail(\"非法帧定义应抛异常\");\n        } catch {"parentUuid":"58b3299d-a35f-45b5-b164-fa54a9ae36c7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ki1l32ugl1bp01sl5ho7xsdk","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a/test/test/DifferentialTest.java","content":"package test;\n\nimport engine.model.ColumnType;\nimport engine.model.Relation;\nimport engine.model.Relation.Row;\nimport engine.window.BoundKind;\nimport engine.window.Frame;\nimport engine.window.FrameBound;\nimport engine.window.FunctionSpec;\nimport engine.window.NullOrder;\nimport engine.window.OrderKey;\nimport engine.window.WindowEngine;\nimport engine.window.WindowSpec;\nimport testutil.NaiveWindowReference;\nimport testutil.Rows;\nimport testutil.TestHarness;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Random;\n\n/**\n * 差分测试：大量随机输入与随机窗口规格，逐行比较生产引擎与\n * {@link NaiveWindowReference} 的结果。固定随机种子，可复现。\n *\n * <p>刻意覆盖：并列键、NULL（含分区键为 NULL）、单行/空分区、\n * 帧端点越界、负值、多函数共存、多列排序、字符串与整数混排。\n */\npublic final class DifferentialTest {\n\n    private static final int ITERATIONS = 300;\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        TestHarness t = new TestHarness(\"差分对拍（引擎 vs 朴素参考）\");\n        Random rnd = new Random(20260923L);\n        int mismatchRows = 0;\n\n        for (int iter = 0; iter < ITERATIONS; iter++) {\n            Generated gen = generate(rnd);\n            Relation engineOut = new WindowEngine().execute(gen.relation, gen.spec);\n            Relation naiveOut = new NaiveWindowReference().run(gen.relation, gen.spec);\n\n            if (!engineOut.columnNames().equals(naiveOut.columnNames())) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：列名不一致\");\n                continue;\n            }\n            if (!Rows.typeNames(engineOut).equals(Rows.typeNames(naiveOut))) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：列类型不一致\");\n                continue;\n            }\n            List<Object[]> a = Rows.canonical(engineOut);\n            List<Object[]> b = Rows.canonical(naiveOut);\n            if (a.size() != b.size()) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：行数 \" + a.size() + \" vs \" + b.size());\n                continue;\n            }\n            for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {\n                Object[] ra = a.get(i);\n                Object[] rb = b.get(i);\n                if (!java.util.Arrays.equals(ra, rb)) {\n                    mismatchRows++;\n                    if (mismatchRows <= 3) {\n                        t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \" 第 \" + i + \" 行不一致：\"\n                                + java.util.Arrays.toString(ra) + \" vs \"\n                                + java.util.Arrays.toString(rb));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        t.check(mismatchRows == 0,\n                mismatchRows == 0 ? ITERATIONS + \" 组随机规格全部对拍一致\"\n                        : \"共 \" + mismatchRows + \" 行结果不一致\");\n\n        // 边界构造：空输入（0 行）\n        Relation empty = WindowEngineTest.relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"});\n        WindowSpec emptySpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                List.of(new OrderKey(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST)),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation e1 = new WindowEngine().execute(empty, emptySpec);\n        Relation e2 = new NaiveWindowReference().run(empty, emptySpec);\n        t.eq(0, e1.rows().size(), \"空输入：引擎产出 0 行\");\n        t.eq(0, e2.rows().size(), \"空输入：参考产出 0 行\");\n        t.eq(3, e1.columnCount() - 2, \"空输入：结果列仍然追加\");\n\n        // 边界构造：分区键全部为 NULL（同一组）\n        Relation nullKeys = WindowEngineTest.relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{null, 2L}, new Object[]{null, 1L});\n        WindowSpec nkSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                List.of(new OrderKey(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST)),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\")));\n        Relation nk1 = new WindowEngine().execute(nullKeys, nkSpec);\n        Relation nk2 = new NaiveWindowReference().run(nullKeys, nkSpec);\n        t.eq(2, nk1.rows().size(), \"NULL 分区键归入同一分区\");\n        t.eq(Rows.canonical(nk1), Rows.canonical(nk2), \"NULL 分区键两实现一致\");\n\n        System.exit(t.report() ? (asc ? NullOrder.NULLS_LAST : NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST)\n                    : (rnd.nextBoolean() ? {"parentUuid":"4c2b4a19-1027-40b9-880e-f74473a01d7f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"63ab520e-48e1-4145-83fb-c4df65ec7e90","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_ki1l32ugl1bp01sl5ho7xsdk","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a/test/test/DifferentialTest.java (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"0c7cc292-2b7c-49c8-97cb-aa9277aaea27","timestamp":"2026-09-23T01:49:31.257Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a/test/test/DifferentialTest.java","content":"package test;\n\nimport engine.model.ColumnType;\nimport engine.model.Relation;\nimport engine.model.Relation.Row;\nimport engine.window.BoundKind;\nimport engine.window.Frame;\nimport engine.window.FrameBound;\nimport engine.window.FunctionSpec;\nimport engine.window.NullOrder;\nimport engine.window.OrderKey;\nimport engine.window.WindowEngine;\nimport engine.window.WindowSpec;\nimport testutil.NaiveWindowReference;\nimport testutil.Rows;\nimport testutil.TestHarness;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Random;\n\n/**\n * 差分测试：大量随机输入与随机窗口规格，逐行比较生产引擎与\n * {@link NaiveWindowReference} 的结果。固定随机种子，可复现。\n *\n * <p>刻意覆盖：并列键、NULL（含分区键为 NULL）、单行/空分区、\n * 帧端点越界、负值、多函数共存、多列排序、字符串与整数混排。\n */\npublic final class DifferentialTest {\n\n    private static final int ITERATIONS = 300;\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        TestHarness t = new TestHarness(\"差分对拍（引擎 vs 朴素参考）\");\n        Random rnd = new Random(20260923L);\n        int mismatchRows = 0;\n\n        for (int iter = 0; iter < ITERATIONS; iter++) {\n            Generated gen = generate(rnd);\n            Relation engineOut = new WindowEngine().execute(gen.relation, gen.spec);\n            Relation naiveOut = new NaiveWindowReference().run(gen.relation, gen.spec);\n\n            if (!engineOut.columnNames().equals(naiveOut.columnNames())) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：列名不一致\");\n                continue;\n            }\n            if (!Rows.typeNames(engineOut).equals(Rows.typeNames(naiveOut))) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：列类型不一致\");\n                continue;\n            }\n            List<Object[]> a = Rows.canonical(engineOut);\n            List<Object[]> b = Rows.canonical(naiveOut);\n            if (a.size() != b.size()) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：行数 \" + a.size() + \" vs \" + b.size());\n                continue;\n            }\n            for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {\n                Object[] ra = a.get(i);\n                Object[] rb = b.get(i);\n                if (!java.util.Arrays.equals(ra, rb)) {\n                    mismatchRows++;\n                    if (mismatchRows <= 3) {\n                        t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \" 第 \" + i + \" 行不一致：\"\n                                + java.util.Arrays.toString(ra) + \" vs \"\n                                + java.util.Arrays.toString(rb));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        t.check(mismatchRows == 0,\n                mismatchRows == 0 ? ITERATIONS + \" 组随机规格全部对拍一致\"\n                        : \"共 \" + mismatchRows + \" 行结果不一致\");\n\n        // 边界构造：空输入（0 行）\n        Relation empty = WindowEngineTest.relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"});\n        WindowSpec emptySpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                List.of(new OrderKey(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST)),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation e1 = new WindowEngine().execute(empty, emptySpec);\n        Relation e2 = new NaiveWindowReference().run(empty, emptySpec);\n        t.eq(0, e1.rows().size(), \"空输入：引擎产出 0 行\");\n        t.eq(0, e2.rows().size(), \"空输入：参考产出 0 行\");\n        t.eq(3, e1.columnCount() - 2, \"空输入：结果列仍然追加\");\n\n        // 边界构造：分区键全部为 NULL（同一组）\n        Relation nullKeys = WindowEngineTest.relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{null, 2L}, new Object[]{null, 1L});\n        WindowSpec nkSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                List.of(new OrderKey(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST)),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\")));\n        Relation nk1 = new WindowEngine().execute(nullKeys, nkSpec);\n        Relation nk2 = new NaiveWindowReference().run(nullKeys, nkSpec);\n        t.eq(2, nk1.rows().size(), \"NULL 分区键归入同一分区\");\n        t.eq(Rows.canonical(nk1), Rows.canonical(nk2), \"NULL 分区键两实现一致\");\n\n        System.exit(t.report() ? 0 : 1);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private record Generated(Relation relation, WindowSpec spec) {\n    }\n\n    private static Generated generate(Random rnd) {\n        // 1..4 列：至少一个 LONG（SUM 参数用），其余随机类型\n        int colCount = 1 + rnd.nextInt(3);\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        names.add(\"c0\");\n        types.add(ColumnType.LONG);\n        for (int c = 1; c < colCount; c++) {\n            names.add(\"c\" + c);\n            types.add(rnd.nextBoolean() ? ColumnType.LONG : ColumnType.STRING);\n        }\n\n        // 0..30 行（空关系、单行、小分区都要覆盖）\n        int rowCount = rnd.nextInt(31);\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>(rowCount);\n        // 小取值域制造大量并列与 NULL\n        String[] strDomain = {\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"a\", null};\n        for (int r = 0; r < rowCount; r++) {\n            Object[] vals = new Object[colCount];\n            for (int c = 0; c < colCount; c++) {\n                if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 25) {\n                    vals[c] = null;\n                } else if (types.get(c) == ColumnType.LONG) {\n                    // 小整数 + 偶尔负值 + 偶尔边界值\n                    int mode = rnd.nextInt(10);\n                    vals[c] = switch (mode) {\n                        case 0 -> (long) rnd.nextInt(7) - 3;\n                        case 1 -> -Math.abs((long) rnd.nextInt(1000));\n                        case 2 -> (long) rnd.nextInt(1000);\n                        default -> (long) rnd.nextInt(5) - 2;\n                    };\n                } else {\n                    vals[c] = strDomain[rnd.nextInt(strDomain.length)];\n                }\n            }\n            rows.add(new Row(r, vals));\n        }\n        Relation rel = new Relation(names, types, rows);\n\n        // 随机分区键/排序键\n        List<String> partBy = pickColumns(rnd, names, 2);\n        List<OrderKey> orderBy = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String c : pickColumns(rnd, names, 2)) {\n            boolean asc = rnd.nextBoolean();\n            NullOrder no = rnd.nextBoolean()\n                    ? (asc ? NullOrder.NULLS_LAST : NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST)\n                    : (rnd.nextBoolean() ? NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST : NullOrder.NULLS_LAST);\n            orderBy.add(new OrderKey(c, asc, no));\n        }\n\n        List<FunctionSpec> fns = new ArrayList<>();\n        fns.add(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"out_rn\"));\n        if (rnd.nextBoolean()) {\n            fns.add(FunctionSpec.rank(\"out_rk\"));\n        }\n        if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 80) {\n            fns.add(FunctionSpec.sum(\"out_sum\", \"c0\", randomFrame(rnd)));\n        }\n        return new Generated(rel, new WindowSpec(partBy, orderBy, fns));\n    }\n\n    private static List<String> pickColumns(Random rnd, List<String> all, int max) {\n        List<String> pool = new ArrayList<>(all);\n        List<String> picked = new ArrayList<>();\n        int n = rnd.nextInt(Math.min(max, pool.size()) + 1);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            picked.add(pool.remove(rnd.nextInt(pool.size())));\n        }\n        return picked;\n    }\n\n    private static Frame randomFrame(Random rnd) {\n        FrameBound start;\n        FrameBound end;\n        int tries = 0;\n        do {\n            start = randomBound(rnd, true);\n            end = randomBound(rnd, false);\n            tries++;\n        } while (start.relativePosition() > end.relativePosition() && tries < 20);\n        if (start.relativePosition() > end.relativePosition()) {\n            return Frame.defaultForSum();\n        }\n        return new Frame(start, end);\n    }\n\n    private static FrameBound randomBound(Random rnd, boolean startSide) {\n        BoundKind[] kinds = startSide\n                ? new BoundKind[]{BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING, BoundKind.PRECEDING, BoundKind.CURRENT_ROW}\n                : new BoundKind[]{BoundKind.CURRENT_ROW, BoundKind.FOLLOWING, BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING};\n        BoundKind kind = kinds[rnd.nextInt(kinds.length)];\n        if (kind == BoundKind.PRECEDING || kind == BoundKind.FOLLOWING) {\n            long off = rnd.nextInt(4); // 0..3：0 会被解析式归一化，这里直接构造 CURRENT ROW\n            if (off == 0) {\n                return FrameBound.currentRow();\n            }\n            return new FrameBound(kind, off);\n        }\n        return new FrameBound(kind, 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4c2b4a19-1027-40b9-880e-f74473a01d7f","session_id":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a","sessionId":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp13-a","slug":"nifty-launching-eich"}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"80e982ed-ddee-4268-a1dd-3daa7917f407","timestamp":"2026-09-23T01:50:14.439Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a/test/test/DifferentialTest.java","oldString":"    public static void main(String[] args) {","newString":"    public static boolean main(String[] args) {","originalFile":"package test;\n\nimport engine.model.ColumnType;\nimport engine.model.Relation;\nimport engine.model.Relation.Row;\nimport engine.window.BoundKind;\nimport engine.window.Frame;\nimport engine.window.FrameBound;\nimport engine.window.FunctionSpec;\nimport engine.window.NullOrder;\nimport engine.window.OrderKey;\nimport engine.window.WindowEngine;\nimport engine.window.WindowSpec;\nimport testutil.NaiveWindowReference;\nimport testutil.Rows;\nimport testutil.TestHarness;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Random;\n\n/**\n * 差分测试：大量随机输入与随机窗口规格，逐行比较生产引擎与\n * {@link NaiveWindowReference} 的结果。固定随机种子，可复现。\n *\n * <p>刻意覆盖：并列键、NULL（含分区键为 NULL）、单行/空分区、\n * 帧端点越界、负值、多函数共存、多列排序、字符串与整数混排。\n */\npublic final class DifferentialTest {\n\n    private static final int ITERATIONS = 300;\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        TestHarness t = new TestHarness(\"差分对拍（引擎 vs 朴素参考）\");\n        Random rnd = new Random(20260923L);\n        int mismatchRows = 0;\n\n        for (int iter = 0; iter < ITERATIONS; iter++) {\n            Generated gen = generate(rnd);\n            Relation engineOut = new WindowEngine().execute(gen.relation, gen.spec);\n            Relation naiveOut = new NaiveWindowReference().run(gen.relation, gen.spec);\n\n            if (!engineOut.columnNames().equals(naiveOut.columnNames())) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：列名不一致\");\n                continue;\n            }\n            if (!Rows.typeNames(engineOut).equals(Rows.typeNames(naiveOut))) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：列类型不一致\");\n                continue;\n            }\n            List<Object[]> a = Rows.canonical(engineOut);\n            List<Object[]> b = Rows.canonical(naiveOut);\n            if (a.size() != b.size()) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：行数 \" + a.size() + \" vs \" + b.size());\n                continue;\n            }\n            for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {\n                Object[] ra = a.get(i);\n                Object[] rb = b.get(i);\n                if (!java.util.Arrays.equals(ra, rb)) {\n                    mismatchRows++;\n                    if (mismatchRows <= 3) {\n                        t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \" 第 \" + i + \" 行不一致：\"\n                                + java.util.Arrays.toString(ra) + \" vs \"\n                                + java.util.Arrays.toString(rb));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        t.check(mismatchRows == 0,\n                mismatchRows == 0 ? ITERATIONS + \" 组随机规格全部对拍一致\"\n                        : \"共 \" + mismatchRows + \" 行结果不一致\");\n\n        // 边界构造：空输入（0 行）\n        Relation empty = WindowEngineTest.relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"});\n        WindowSpec emptySpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                List.of(new OrderKey(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST)),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation e1 = new WindowEngine().execute(empty, emptySpec);\n        Relation e2 = new NaiveWindowReference().run(empty, emptySpec);\n        t.eq(0, e1.rows().size(), \"空输入：引擎产出 0 行\");\n        t.eq(0, e2.rows().size(), \"空输入：参考产出 0 行\");\n        t.eq(3, e1.columnCount() - 2, \"空输入：结果列仍然追加\");\n\n        // 边界构造：分区键全部为 NULL（同一组）\n        Relation nullKeys = WindowEngineTest.relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{null, 2L}, new Object[]{null, 1L});\n        WindowSpec nkSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                List.of(new OrderKey(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST)),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\")));\n        Relation nk1 = new WindowEngine().execute(nullKeys, nkSpec);\n        Relation nk2 = new NaiveWindowReference().run(nullKeys, nkSpec);\n        t.eq(2, nk1.rows().size(), \"NULL 分区键归入同一分区\");\n        t.eq(Rows.canonical(nk1), Rows.canonical(nk2), \"NULL 分区键两实现一致\");\n\n        System.exit(t.report() ? 0 : 1);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private record Generated(Relation relation, WindowSpec spec) {\n    }\n\n    private static Generated generate(Random rnd) {\n        // 1..4 列：至少一个 LONG（SUM 参数用），其余随机类型\n        int colCount = 1 + rnd.nextInt(3);\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        names.add(\"c0\");\n        types.add(ColumnType.LONG);\n        for (int c = 1; c < colCount; c++) {\n            names.add(\"c\" + c);\n            types.add(rnd.nextBoolean() ? ColumnType.LONG : ColumnType.STRING);\n        }\n\n        // 0..30 行（空关系、单行、小分区都要覆盖）\n        int rowCount = rnd.nextInt(31);\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>(rowCount);\n        // 小取值域制造大量并列与 NULL\n        String[] strDomain = {\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"a\", null};\n        for (int r = 0; r < rowCount; r++) {\n            Object[] vals = new Object[colCount];\n            for (int c = 0; c < colCount; c++) {\n                if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 25) {\n                    vals[c] = null;\n                } else if (types.get(c) == ColumnType.LONG) {\n                    // 小整数 + 偶尔负值 + 偶尔边界值\n                    int mode = rnd.nextInt(10);\n                    vals[c] = switch (mode) {\n                        case 0 -> (long) rnd.nextInt(7) - 3;\n                        case 1 -> -Math.abs((long) rnd.nextInt(1000));\n                        case 2 -> (long) rnd.nextInt(1000);\n                        default -> (long) rnd.nextInt(5) - 2;\n                    };\n                } else {\n                    vals[c] = strDomain[rnd.nextInt(strDomain.length)];\n                }\n            }\n            rows.add(new Row(r, vals));\n        }\n        Relation rel = new Relation(names, types, rows);\n\n        // 随机分区键/排序键\n        List<String> partBy = pickColumns(rnd, names, 2);\n        List<OrderKey> orderBy = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String c : pickColumns(rnd, names, 2)) {\n            boolean asc = rnd.nextBoolean();\n            NullOrder no = rnd.nextBoolean()\n                    ? (asc ? NullOrder.NULLS_LAST : NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST)\n                    : (rnd.nextBoolean() ? NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST : NullOrder.NULLS_LAST);\n            orderBy.add(new OrderKey(c, asc, no));\n        }\n\n        List<FunctionSpec> fns = new ArrayList<>();\n        fns.add(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"out_rn\"));\n        if (rnd.nextBoolean()) {\n            fns.add(FunctionSpec.rank(\"out_rk\"));\n        }\n        if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 80) {\n            fns.add(FunctionSpec.sum(\"out_sum\", \"c0\", randomFrame(rnd)));\n        }\n        return new Generated(rel, new WindowSpec(partBy, orderBy, fns));\n    }\n\n    private static List<String> pickColumns(Random rnd, List<String> all, int max) {\n        List<String> pool = new ArrayList<>(all);\n        List<String> picked = new ArrayList<>();\n        int n = rnd.nextInt(Math.min(max, pool.size()) + 1);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            picked.add(pool.remove(rnd.nextInt(pool.size())));\n        }\n        return picked;\n    }\n\n    private static Frame randomFrame(Random rnd) {\n        FrameBound start;\n        FrameBound end;\n        int tries = 0;\n        do {\n            start = randomBound(rnd, true);\n            end = randomBound(rnd, false);\n            tries++;\n        } while (start.relativePosition() > end.relativePosition() && tries < 20);\n        if (start.relativePosition() > end.relativePosition()) {\n            return Frame.defaultForSum();\n        }\n        return new Frame(start, end);\n    }\n\n    private static FrameBound randomBound(Random rnd, boolean startSide) {\n        BoundKind[] kinds = startSide\n                ? new BoundKind[]{BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING, BoundKind.PRECEDING, BoundKind.CURRENT_ROW}\n                : new BoundKind[]{BoundKind.CURRENT_ROW, BoundKind.FOLLOWING, BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING};\n        BoundKind kind = kinds[rnd.nextInt(kinds.length)];\n        if (kind == BoundKind.PRECEDING || kind == BoundKind.FOLLOWING) {\n            long off = rnd.nextInt(4); // 0..3：0 会被解析式归一化，这里直接构造 CURRENT ROW\n            if (off == 0) {\n                return FrameBound.currentRow();\n            }\n            return new FrameBound(kind, off);\n        }\n        return new FrameBound(kind, 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":30,"oldLines":7,"newStart":30,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ","     private static final int ITERATIONS = 300;"," ","-    public static void main(String[] args) {","+    public static boolean main(String[] args) {","         TestHarness t = new TestHarness(\"差分对拍（引擎 vs 朴素参考）\");","         Random rnd = new Random(20260923L);","         int mismatchRows = 0;"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"cf0497ac-a804-47e3-84e7-b07bdf6da3bb","session_id":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a","sessionId":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp13-a","slug":"nifty-launching-eich"}

NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST : NullOrder.NULLS_LAST);\n            orderBy.add(new OrderKey(c, asc, no));\n        }\n\n        List<FunctionSpec> fns = new ArrayList<>();\n        fns.add(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"out_rn\"));\n        if (rnd.nextBoolean()) {\n            fns.add(FunctionSpec.rank(\"out_rk\"));\n        }\n        if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 80) {\n            fns.add(FunctionSpec.sum(\"out_sum\", \"c0\", randomFrame(rnd)));\n        }\n        return new Generated(rel, new WindowSpec(partBy, orderBy, fns));\n    }\n\n    private static List<String> pickColumns(Random rnd, List<String> all, int max) {\n        List<String> pool = new ArrayList<>(all);\n        List<String> picked = new ArrayList<>();\n        int n = rnd.nextInt(Math.min(max, pool.size()) + 1);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            picked.add(pool.remove(rnd.nextInt(pool.size())));\n        }\n        return picked;\n    }\n\n    private static Frame randomFrame(Random rnd) {\n        FrameBound start;\n        FrameBound end;\n        int tries = 0;\n        do {\n            start = randomBound(rnd, true);\n            end = randomBound(rnd, false);\n            tries++;\n        } while (start.relativePosition() > end.relativePosition() && tries < 20);\n        if (start.relativePosition() > end.relativePosition()) {\n            return Frame.defaultForSum();\n        }\n        return new Frame(start, end);\n    }\n\n    private static FrameBound randomBound(Random rnd, boolean startSide) {\n        BoundKind[] kinds = startSide\n                ? new BoundKind[]{BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING, BoundKind.PRECEDING, BoundKind.CURRENT_ROW}\n                : new BoundKind[]{BoundKind.CURRENT_ROW, BoundKind.FOLLOWING, BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING};\n        BoundKind kind = kinds[rnd.nextInt(kinds.length)];\n        if (kind == BoundKind.PRECEDING || kind == BoundKind.FOLLOWING) {\n            long off = rnd.nextInt(4); // 0..3：0 会被解析式归一化，这里直接构造 CURRENT ROW\n            if (off == 0) {\n                return FrameBound.currentRow();\n            }\n            return new FrameBound(kind, off);\n        }\n        return new FrameBound(kind, 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":95,"oldLines":7,"newStart":95,"newLines":7,"lines":["         t.eq(2, nk1.rows().size(), \"NULL 分区键归入同一分区\");","         t.eq(Rows.canonical(nk1), Rows.canonical(nk2), \"NULL 分区键两实现一致\");"," ","-        System.exit(t.report() ? {"parentUuid":"b945ada7-9de1-499c-9ee3-e3db33639a5c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"signature":"","thinking":"Several real bugs found:\n\n1. \n\nI've confirmed the first two real bugs: the first is a null pointer exception in orderComparator, caused by test helper allowing null rows, requiring fixes in two related test data locations. Further analysis of this bug reveals that the entire rows of test data differ in earlier columns, leading to inconsistent canonical row sorting standards. It has also been tentatively confirmed that the 5th column is the ROW_NUMBER output, as the sum function is only included in the function list and rank is not involved.\n\nAfter further cross-checking, I've corrected my earlier conclusion on the output column count: there are 4 input columns, 2 output columns correspond to ROW_NUMBER and SUM respectively, and ROW_NUMBER is the first output column.\n\nThe co-occurrence of identical SUM values for the same data row with different ROW_NUMBER outputs points to a systematic ordering difference rather than a random coincidence. I've checked the sorting logic of both implementations and confirmed they are both properly configured. I've also found that the engine's comparison logic may throw an exception when comparing values of different types.\n\nI've verified that column types within each column are fixed, ruled out the possibility of type comparison anomalies, rechecked the random value generation and ROW_NUMBER calculation logic, and reconfirmed the 5th column as the ROW_NUMBER output based on the previously confirmed value matching situation.\n\nI've confirmed the canonical sorting standard aligns with full-row lexicographic order. The two test rows have identical non-key input columns, so both implementations produce different ROW_NUMBER and SUM value pairs. The naive implementation assigns the same ROW_NUMBER to these two rows, while the engine returns different values.\n\nAfter further analysis, I found that the naive rank function incorrectly uses the full order comparator including sourceIndex for tie-breaking, which deviates from the basic rule that rank should only be determined by order keys. I also reconfirmed the column count is 4 input columns plus 2 function output columns, and will run the iteration 4 test in isolation for further verification.\n\nI will first fix two obvious issues and the executor error handling issue, then rerun the iteration 4 test with full details. The executor treats missing required fields as JSON parse error, which is actually an invalid request, and I will add a dedicated request field helper to handle this properly.\n\nI'll add a dedicated field access helper to the executor and replace all existing require calls with this new helper. I'm currently troubleshooting the failed ASC default NULLS LAST test, having ruled out issues with field missing handling, test data matching and engine logic, and am now checking for problems with the order comparator.\n\nI've ruled out multiple possible causes for the ASC default NULLS LAST test failure, and suspect it may share a root cause with the earlier differential test: null handling during ordering. The two test rows involved are all-null rows in the partition, and the engine and naive implementation return different ROW_NUMBER values for them.\n\nI've confirmed both the engine and naive implementation follow the same null sorting rule for ASC order by. The engine returns a smaller ROW_NUMBER for all-null test rows, which may be the root cause of the earlier differential test mismatch.\n\nI've ruled out multiple potential causes for the ASC default NULLS LAST test failure, including issues with the naive implementation's comparator, closure, cell comparison logic and partition logic. I've also confirmed the ROW_NUMBER values returned by the engine and naive implementation are different for all-null rows. java.math.BigInteger;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Comparator;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 朴素逐行窗口参考实现：刻意写得“直白、O(n²)、与生产引擎不同构”，\n * 作为差分测试（differential testing）的对照基准。\n *\n * <p>做法：用 HashMap 按分区键值分组 → 各组用独立编写的比较器排序 →\n * ROW_NUMBER/RANK 逐行扫描 → SUM 对每行用双重 for 循环在帧内逐行累加。\n *\n * <p>溢出契约与生产引擎一致：帧内非 NULL 整数的“数学和”超出 long\n * 范围即报错（这里逐行 {@link BigInteger#add} 后一次性 longValueExact，\n * 不用前缀和），因此两侧在负值抵消场景下结论相同。\n */\npublic final class NaiveWindowReference {\n\n    private Relation input;\n    private WindowSpec spec;\n\n    public Relation run(Relation input, WindowSpec spec) {\n        this.input = input;\n        this.spec = spec;\n\n        // 1) 按分区键值朴素分组\n        Map<List<Object>, List<Row>> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        List<Integer> partCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String p : spec.partitionBy()) {\n            partCols.add(input.columnIndex(p));\n        }\n        for (Row row : input.rows()) {\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int c : partCols) {\n                key.add(row.get(c));\n            }\n            groups.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(row);\n        }\n\n        // 2) 输出列\n        List<String> outNames = new ArrayList<>(input.columnNames());\n        List<ColumnType> outTypes = new ArrayList<>(input.columnTypes());\n        for (FunctionSpec f : spec.functions()) {\n            outNames.add(f.outputColumn());\n            outTypes.add(ColumnType.LONG);\n        }\n\n        // 3) 每组排序后逐行求值，直接产出结果行\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (List<Row> group : groups.values()) {\n            group.sort(groupComparator());\n            for (int i = 0; i < group.size(); i++) {\n                Object[] values = new Object[outNames.size()];\n                Row src = group.get(i);\n                System.arraycopy(src.values, 0, values, 0, input.columnCount());\n                int col = input.columnCount();\n                for (FunctionSpec f : spec.functions()) {\n                    values[col++] = eval(f, group, i);\n                }\n                out.add(new Row(src.sourceIndex, values));\n            }\n        }\n        return new Relation(outNames, outTypes, out);\n    }\n\n    private Object eval(FunctionSpec f, List<Row> group, int i) {\n        switch (f.function()) {\n            case ROW_NUMBER:\n                return (long) i + 1;\n            case RANK:\n                return naiveRank(group, i);\n            case SUM:\n                return naiveSum(f, group, i);\n            default:\n                throw new AssertionError();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private long naiveRank(List<Row> group, int i) {\n        // 从头数：有多少行的排序键严格“小于等于组内不同键”——\n        // 直接数严格小于当前行的行数，加 1。\n        long rank = 1;\n        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {\n            if (orderCompare(group.get(j), group.get(i)) < 0) {\n                rank++;\n            }\n        }\n        return rank;\n    }\n\n    private Object naiveSum(FunctionSpec f, List<Row> group, int i) {\n        int arg = input.columnIndex(f.argumentColumn());\n        Frame frame = f.frame();\n        long loRaw = resolveIndex(frame.start(), i);\n        long hiRaw = resolveIndex(frame.end(), i);\n        int n = group.size();\n        if (hiRaw < 0 || loRaw > n - 1) {\n            return null; // 整帧在分区外\n        }\n        int lo = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, loRaw));\n        int hi = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, hiRaw));\n\n        BigInteger acc = BigInteger.ZERO;\n        boolean any = false;\n        for (int j = lo; j <= hi; j++) {\n            Object v = group.get(j).get(arg);\n            if (v != null) {\n                acc = acc.add(BigInteger.valueOf((Long) v));\n                any = true;\n            }\n        }\n        if (!any) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        try {\n            return acc.longValueExact();\n        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {\n            throw new WindowException(String.format(\n                    \"[参考实现] 窗口求和溢出 long：SUM(%s) AS %s，帧 %s，第 %d/%d 行，和 = %s\",\n                    f.argumentColumn(), f.outputColumn(), frame.toSql(), i + 1, n, acc));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private long resolveIndex(engine.window.FrameBound b, int current) {\n        return switch (b.kind()) {\n            case UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING -> Long.MIN_VALUE;\n            case PRECEDING -> current - b.offset();\n            case CURRENT_ROW -> current;\n            case FOLLOWING -> current + b.offset();\n            case UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING -> Long.MAX_VALUE;\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Comparator<Row> groupComparator() {\n        return (a, b) -> {\n            for (OrderKey k : spec.orderBy()) {\n                int col = input.columnIndex(k.column());\n                Object x = a.get(col);\n                Object y = b.get(col);\n                int cmp;\n                if (x == null && y == null) {\n                    cmp = 0;\n                } else if (x == null) {\n                    cmp = k.nullOrder() == NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST ? -1 : 1;\n                } else if (y == null) {\n                    cmp = k.nullOrder() == NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST ? 1 : -1;\n                } else {\n                    cmp = cellCompare(x, y);\n                    if (!k.ascending()) {\n                        cmp = -cmp;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (cmp != 0) {\n                    return cmp;\n                }\n            }\n            return Long.compare(a.sourceIndex, b.sourceIndex);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private int orderCompare(Row a, Row b) {\n        return groupComparator().compare(a, b);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static int cellCompare(Object a, Object b) {\n        if (a instanceof Long && b instanceof Long) {\n            return Long.compare((Long) a, (Long) b);\n        }\n        return ((Comparable<Object>) a).compareTo(b);\n    }\n\n    /** 仅供测试统计：函数类型枚举引用便捷方法。 */\n    public static boolean isSum(WindowFunction f) {\n        return f == WindowFunction.SUM;\n java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Comparator;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 朴素逐行窗口参考实现：刻意写得“直白、O(n²)、与生产引擎不同构”，\n * 作为差分测试（differential testing）的对照基准。\n *\n * <p>做法：用 HashMap 按分区键值分组 → 各组用独立编写的比较器排序 →\n * ROW_NUMBER/RANK 逐行扫描 → SUM 对每行用双重 for 循环在帧内逐行累加。\n *\n * <p>溢出契约与生产引擎一致：帧内非 NULL 整数的“数学和”超出 long\n * 范围即报错（这里逐行 {@link BigInteger#add} 后一次性 longValueExact，\n * 不用前缀和），因此两侧在负值抵消场景下结论相同。\n */\npublic final class NaiveWindowReference {\n\n    private Relation input;\n    private WindowSpec spec;\n\n    public Relation run(Relation input, WindowSpec spec) {\n        this.input = input;\n        this.spec = spec;\n\n        // 1) 按分区键值朴素分组\n        Map<List<Object>, List<Row>> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        List<Integer> partCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String p : spec.partitionBy()) {\n            partCols.add(input.columnIndex(p));\n        }\n        for (Row row : input.rows()) {\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int c : partCols) {\n                key.add(row.get(c));\n            }\n            groups.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(row);\n        }\n\n        // 2) 输出列\n        List<String> outNames = new ArrayList<>(input.columnNames());\n        List<ColumnType> outTypes = new ArrayList<>(input.columnTypes());\n        for (FunctionSpec f : spec.functions()) {\n            outNames.add(f.outputColumn());\n            outTypes.add(ColumnType.LONG);\n        }\n\n        // 3) 每组排序后逐行求值，直接产出结果行\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (List<Row> group : groups.values()) {\n            group.sort(groupComparator());\n            for (int i = 0; i < group.size(); i++) {\n                Object[] values = new Object[outNames.size()];\n                Row src = group.get(i);\n                System.arraycopy(src.values, 0, values, 0, input.columnCount());\n                int col = input.columnCount();\n                for (FunctionSpec f : spec.functions()) {\n                    values[col++] = eval(f, group, i);\n                }\n                out.add(new Row(src.sourceIndex, values));\n            }\n        }\n        return new Relation(outNames, outTypes, out);\n    }\n\n    private Object eval(FunctionSpec f, List<Row> group, int i) {\n        switch (f.function()) {\n            case ROW_NUMBER:\n                return (long) i + 1;\n            case RANK:\n                return naiveRank(group, i);\n            case SUM:\n                return naiveSum(f, group, i);\n            default:\n                throw new AssertionError();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private long naiveRank(List<Row> group, int i) {\n        // 名次 = 排序键严格小于当前行的行数 + 1。\n        // 注意：必须只按 ORDER BY 键比较，不能含 sourceIndex 决胜键，\n        // 否则并列键永远不会被判为相等。\n        long rank = 1;\n        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {\n            if (orderKeysCompare(group.get(j), group.get(i)) < 0) {\n                rank++;\n            }\n        }\n        return rank;\n    }\n\n    private Object naiveSum(FunctionSpec f, List<Row> group, int i) {\n        int arg = input.columnIndex(f.argumentColumn());\n        Frame frame = f.frame();\n        long loRaw = resolveIndex(frame.start(), i);\n        long hiRaw = resolveIndex(frame.end(), i);\n        int n = group.size();\n        if (hiRaw < 0 || loRaw > n - 1) {\n            return null; // 整帧在分区外\n        }\n        int lo = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, loRaw));\n        int hi = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, hiRaw));\n\n        BigInteger acc = BigInteger.ZERO;\n        boolean any = false;\n        for (int j = lo; j <= hi; j++) {\n            Object v = group.get(j).get(arg);\n            if (v != null) {\n                acc = acc.add(BigInteger.valueOf((Long) v));\n                any = true;\n            }\n        }\n        if (!any) {\n            return null;\n        }\n        try {\n            return acc.longValueExact();\n        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {\n            throw new WindowException(String.format(\n                    \"[参考实现] 窗口求和溢出 long：SUM(%s) AS %s，帧 %s，第 %d/%d 行，和 = %s\",\n                    f.argumentColumn(), f.outputColumn(), frame.toSql(), i + 1, n, acc));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private long resolveIndex(engine.window.FrameBound b, int current) {\n        return switch (b.kind()) {\n            case UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING -> Long.MIN_VALUE;\n            case PRECEDING -> current - b.offset();\n            case CURRENT_ROW -> current;\n            case FOLLOWING -> current + b.offset();\n            case UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING -> Long.MAX_VALUE;\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Comparator<Row> groupComparator() {\n        return (a, b) -> {\n            for (OrderKey k : spec.orderBy()) {\n                int col = input.columnIndex(k.column());\n                Object x = a.get(col);\n                Object y = b.get(col);\n                int cmp;\n                if (x == null && y == null) {\n                    cmp = 0;\n                } else if (x == null) {\n                    cmp = k.nullOrder() == NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST ? -1 : 1;\n                } else if (y == null) {\n                    cmp = k.nullOrder() == NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST ? 1 : -1;\n                } else {\n                    cmp = cellCompare(x, y);\n                    if (!k.ascending()) {\n                        cmp = -cmp;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (cmp != 0) {\n                    return cmp;\n                }\n            }\n            return Long.compare(a.sourceIndex, b.sourceIndex);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private int orderCompare(Row a, Row b) {\n        return groupComparator().compare(a, b);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static int cellCompare(Object a, Object b) {\n        if (a instanceof Long && b instanceof Long) {\n            return Long.compare((Long) a, (Long) b);\n        }\n        return ((Comparable<Object>) a).compareTo(b);\n    }\n\n    /** 仅供测试统计：函数类型枚举引用便捷方法。 */\n    public static boolean isSum(WindowFunction f) {\n        return f == WindowFunction.SUM;\n c2.get(1)),\n                \"NULL 分区键两实现一致\");","originalFile":"package test;\n\nimport engine.model.ColumnType;\nimport engine.model.Relation;\nimport engine.model.Relation.Row;\nimport engine.window.BoundKind;\nimport engine.window.Frame;\nimport engine.window.FrameBound;\nimport engine.window.FunctionSpec;\nimport engine.window.NullOrder;\nimport engine.window.OrderKey;\nimport engine.window.WindowEngine;\nimport engine.window.WindowSpec;\nimport testutil.NaiveWindowReference;\nimport testutil.Rows;\nimport testutil.TestHarness;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Random;\n\n/**\n * 差分测试：大量随机输入与随机窗口规格，逐行比较生产引擎与\n * {@link NaiveWindowReference} 的结果。固定随机种子，可复现。\n *\n * <p>刻意覆盖：并列键、NULL（含分区键为 NULL）、单行/空分区、\n * 帧端点越界、负值、多函数共存、多列排序、字符串与整数混排。\n */\npublic final class DifferentialTest {\n\n    private static final int ITERATIONS = 300;\n\n    public static boolean main(String[] args) {\n        TestHarness t = new TestHarness(\"差分对拍（引擎 vs 朴素参考）\");\n        Random rnd = new Random(20260923L);\n        int mismatchRows = 0;\n\n        for (int iter = 0; iter < ITERATIONS; iter++) {\n            Generated gen = generate(rnd);\n            Relation engineOut = new WindowEngine().execute(gen.relation, gen.spec);\n            Relation naiveOut = new NaiveWindowReference().run(gen.relation, gen.spec);\n\n            if (!engineOut.columnNames().equals(naiveOut.columnNames())) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：列名不一致\");\n                continue;\n            }\n            if (!Rows.typeNames(engineOut).equals(Rows.typeNames(naiveOut))) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：列类型不一致\");\n                continue;\n            }\n            List<Object[]> a = Rows.canonical(engineOut);\n            List<Object[]> b = Rows.canonical(naiveOut);\n            if (a.size() != b.size()) {\n                t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \"：行数 \" + a.size() + \" vs \" + b.size());\n                continue;\n            }\n            for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {\n                Object[] ra = a.get(i);\n                Object[] rb = b.get(i);\n                if (!java.util.Arrays.equals(ra, rb)) {\n                    mismatchRows++;\n                    if (mismatchRows <= 3) {\n                        t.fail(\"迭代 \" + iter + \" 第 \" + i + \" 行不一致：\"\n                                + java.util.Arrays.toString(ra) + \" vs \"\n                                + java.util.Arrays.toString(rb));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        t.check(mismatchRows == 0,\n                mismatchRows == 0 ? ITERATIONS + \" 组随机规格全部对拍一致\"\n                        : \"共 \" + mismatchRows + \" 行结果不一致\");\n\n        // 边界构造：空输入（0 行）\n        Relation empty = WindowEngineTest.relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"});\n        WindowSpec emptySpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                List.of(new OrderKey(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST)),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.rank(\"rk\"),\n                        FunctionSpec.sum(\"s\", \"v\", Frame.defaultForSum())));\n        Relation e1 = new WindowEngine().execute(empty, emptySpec);\n        Relation e2 = new NaiveWindowReference().run(empty, emptySpec);\n        t.eq(0, e1.rows().size(), \"空输入：引擎产出 0 行\");\n        t.eq(0, e2.rows().size(), \"空输入：参考产出 0 行\");\n        t.eq(3, e1.columnCount() - 2, \"空输入：结果列仍然追加\");\n\n        // 边界构造：分区键全部为 NULL（同一组）\n        Relation nullKeys = WindowEngineTest.relation(new String[]{\"p:STRING\", \"v:LONG\"},\n                new Object[]{null, 2L}, new Object[]{null, 1L});\n        WindowSpec nkSpec = new WindowSpec(List.of(\"p\"),\n                List.of(new OrderKey(\"v\", true, NullOrder.NULLS_LAST)),\n                List.of(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"rn\")));\n        Relation nk1 = new WindowEngine().execute(nullKeys, nkSpec);\n        Relation nk2 = new NaiveWindowReference().run(nullKeys, nkSpec);\n        t.eq(2, nk1.rows().size(), \"NULL 分区键归入同一分区\");\n        t.eq(Rows.canonical(nk1), Rows.canonical(nk2), \"NULL 分区键两实现一致\");\n\n        return t.report();\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private record Generated(Relation relation, WindowSpec spec) {\n    }\n\n    private static Generated generate(Random rnd) {\n        // 1..4 列：至少一个 LONG（SUM 参数用），其余随机类型\n        int colCount = 1 + rnd.nextInt(3);\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        names.add(\"c0\");\n        types.add(ColumnType.LONG);\n        for (int c = 1; c < colCount; c++) {\n            names.add(\"c\" + c);\n            types.add(rnd.nextBoolean() ? ColumnType.LONG : ColumnType.STRING);\n        }\n\n        // 0..30 行（空关系、单行、小分区都要覆盖）\n        int rowCount = rnd.nextInt(31);\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>(rowCount);\n        // 小取值域制造大量并列与 NULL\n        String[] strDomain = {\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"a\", null};\n        for (int r = 0; r < rowCount; r++) {\n            Object[] vals = new Object[colCount];\n            for (int c = 0; c < colCount; c++) {\n                if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 25) {\n                    vals[c] = null;\n                } else if (types.get(c) == ColumnType.LONG) {\n                    // 小整数 + 偶尔负值 + 偶尔边界值\n                    int mode = rnd.nextInt(10);\n                    vals[c] = switch (mode) {\n                        case 0 -> (long) rnd.nextInt(7) - 3;\n                        case 1 -> -Math.abs((long) rnd.nextInt(1000));\n                        case 2 -> (long) rnd.nextInt(1000);\n                        default -> (long) rnd.nextInt(5) - 2;\n                    };\n                } else {\n                    vals[c] = strDomain[rnd.nextInt(strDomain.length)];\n                }\n            }\n            rows.add(new Row(r, vals));\n        }\n        Relation rel = new Relation(names, types, rows);\n\n        // 随机分区键/排序键\n        List<String> partBy = pickColumns(rnd, names, 2);\n        List<OrderKey> orderBy = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String c : pickColumns(rnd, names, 2)) {\n            boolean asc = rnd.nextBoolean();\n            NullOrder no = rnd.nextBoolean()\n                    ? (asc ? NullOrder.NULLS_LAST : NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST)\n                    : (rnd.nextBoolean() ? NullOrder.NULLS_FIRST : NullOrder.NULLS_LAST);\n            orderBy.add(new OrderKey(c, asc, no));\n        }\n\n        List<FunctionSpec> fns = new ArrayList<>();\n        fns.add(FunctionSpec.rowNumber(\"out_rn\"));\n        if (rnd.nextBoolean()) {\n            fns.add(FunctionSpec.rank(\"out_rk\"));\n        }\n        if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 80) {\n            fns.add(FunctionSpec.sum(\"out_sum\", \"c0\", randomFrame(rnd)));\n        }\n        return new Generated(rel, new WindowSpec(partBy, orderBy, fns));\n    }\n\n    private static List<String> pickColumns(Random rnd, List<String> all, int max) {\n        List<String> pool = new ArrayList<>(all);\n        List<String> picked = new ArrayList<>();\n        int n = rnd.nextInt(Math.min(max, pool.size()) + 1);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            picked.add(pool.remove(rnd.nextInt(pool.size())));\n        }\n        return picked;\n    }\n\n    private static Frame randomFrame(Random rnd) {\n        FrameBound start;\n        FrameBound end;\n        int tries = 0;\n        do {\n            start = randomBound(rnd, true);\n            end = randomBound(rnd, false);\n            tries++;\n        } while (start.relativePosition() > end.relativePosition() && tries < 20);\n        if (start.relativePosition() > end.relativePosition()) {\n            return Frame.defaultForSum();\n        }\n        return new Frame(start, end);\n    }\n\n    private static FrameBound randomBound(Random rnd, boolean startSide) {\n        BoundKind[] kinds = startSide\n                ? new BoundKind[]{BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING, BoundKind.PRECEDING, BoundKind.CURRENT_ROW}\n                : new BoundKind[]{BoundKind.CURRENT_ROW, BoundKind.FOLLOWING, BoundKind.UNBOUNDED_FOLLOWING};\n        BoundKind kind = kinds[rnd.nextInt(kinds.length)];\n        if (kind == BoundKind.PRECEDING || kind == BoundKind.FOLLOWING) {\n            long off = rnd.nextInt(4); // 0..3：0 会被解析式归一化，这里直接构造 CURRENT ROW\n            if (off == 0) {\n                return FrameBound.currentRow();\n            }\n            return new FrameBound(kind, off);\n        }\n        return new FrameBound(kind, 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":93,"oldLines":7,"newStart":93,"newLines":12,"lines":["         Relation nk1 = new WindowEngine().execute(nullKeys, nkSpec);","         Relation nk2 = new NaiveWindowReference().run(nullKeys, nkSpec);","         t.eq(2, nk1.rows().size(), \"NULL 分区键归入同一分区\");","-        t.eq(Rows.canonical(nk1), Rows.canonical(nk2), \"NULL 分区键两实现一致\");","+        List<Object[]> c1 = Rows.canonical(nk1);","+        List<Object[]> c2 = Rows.canonical(nk2);","+        t.check(c1.size() == c2.size()","+                        && java.util.Arrays.equals(c1.get(0), c2.get(0))","+                        && java.util.Arrays.equals(c1.get(1), c2.get(1)),","+                \"NULL 分区键两实现一致\");"," ","         return t.report();","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"1e10d603-b2be-4968-839f-4726c6e72743","session_id":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp13/a","sessionId":"6ee1f3a6-b29b-4c5b-ba12-0dfe3171c7cf","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp13-a","slug":"nifty-launching-eich"}

[null]\");","originalFile":"package test;\n\nimport engine.executor.RequestExecutor;\nimport testutil.TestHarness;\n\n/** JSON 入口端到端测试：请求解析、计划/数据导出、错误响应与退出语义。 */\npublic final class ExecutorTest {\n\n    public static boolean main(String[] args) {\n        TestHarness t = new TestHarness(\"JSON 请求入口\");\n\n        // 完整请求：分区、排序、三个函数、计划导出\n        String request = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"includePlan\": true,\n                  \"input\": {\n                    \"columns\": [\n                      {\"name\": \"dept\", \"type\": \"STRING\"},\n                      {\"name\": \"score\", \"type\": \"LONG\"}\n                    ],\n                    \"rows\": [\n                      [\"eng\", 80],\n                      [\"eng\", 90],\n                      [\"sales\", 70],\n                      [\"eng\", 80],\n                      [\"sales\", null]\n                    ]\n                  },\n                  \"window\": {\n                    \"partitionBy\": [\"dept\"],\n                    \"orderBy\": [{\"column\": \"score\", \"ascending\": false, \"nullOrder\": \"NULLS_FIRST\"}],\n                    \"functions\": [\n                      {\"type\": \"ROW_NUMBER\", \"outputColumn\": \"rn\"},\n                      {\"type\": \"RANK\", \"outputColumn\": \"rk\"},\n                      {\"type\": \"SUM\", \"outputColumn\": \"moving_sum\", \"argument\": \"score\",\n                       \"frame\": {\"mode\": \"ROWS\",\n                                 \"start\": {\"kind\": \"UNBOUNDED_PRECEDING\"},\n                                 \"end\":   {\"kind\": \"CURRENT_ROW\"}}}\n                    ]\n                  }\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        RequestExecutor ex = new RequestExecutor();\n        String resp = ex.execute(request);\n        t.check(!ex.lastRequestFailed, \"完整请求成功\");\n        t.check(resp.contains(\"\\\"ok\\\": true\"), \"响应 ok=true\");\n        t.check(resp.contains(\"\\\"plan\\\"\"), \"响应包含执行计划\");\n        t.check(resp.contains(\"\\\"partitionBy\\\"\"), \"计划含分区信息\");\n        t.check(resp.contains(\"ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW\"),\n                \"计划含可阅读的帧定义\");\n        t.check(resp.contains(\"\\\"moving_sum\\\"\"), \"响应含结果列\");\n        t.check(resp.contains(\"\\\"rowCount\\\": 5\"), \"响应含行数 5\");\n\n        // 直接核对部分输出：eng 分区 DESC 排序为 90,80,80\n        // RANK: 1,2,2；累计和: 90,170,250\n        t.check(resp.contains(\"\\\"rk\\\"\"), \"RANK 列存在\");\n        t.check(resp.contains(\"250\"), \"eng 组 90+80+80 累计和 250 出现\");\n        t.check(resp.contains(\"170\"), \"eng 组 90+80=170 出现\");\n\n        // 仅导出计划（includeData=false）\n        String planOnly = new RequestExecutor().execute(\n                request.replace(\"\\\"includePlan\\\": true\",\n                        \"\\\"includePlan\\\": true, \\\"includeData\\\": false\"));\n        t.check(planOnly.contains(\"\\\"plan\\\"\") && !planOnly.contains(\"\\\"output\\\"\"),\n                \"includeData=false 时只导出计划\");\n\n        // 默认 NULL 顺序：ASC 缺省 nullOrder\n        String defaults = \"\"\"\n                {\"input\": {\"columns\": [{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"LONG\"}], \"rows\": [[1],[null]]},\n                 \"window\": {\"orderBy\": [{\"column\": \"v\"}],\n                            \"functions\": [{\"type\": \"ROW_NUMBER\", \"outputColumn\": \"rn\"}]}}\n                \"\"\";\n        String dResp = new RequestExecutor().execute(defaults);\n        engine.json.Json.JObj dRoot = (engine.json.Json.JObj) engine.json.JsonParser.parse(dResp);\n        engine.json.Json.JArr dRows = (engine.json.Json.JArr)\n                ((engine.json.Json.JObj) dRoot.get(\"output\")).get(\"rows\");\n        // ASC NULLS LAST：排序后第一行是 [1]，第二行是 [null]\n        t.eq(1L, ((engine.json.Json.JLong) dRows.items.get(0) instanceof engine.json.Json.JArr ra0\n                ? ra0.items.get(0) : ((engine.json.Json.JArr) dRows.items.get(0)).items.get(0))\n                instanceof engine.json.Json.JLong zz ? zz.value() : null,\n                \"ASC 缺省 NULLS LAST：首行值为 1\");\n        t.check(dRows.items.get(0) instanceof engine.json.Json.JArr rr0\n                        && rr0.items.get(0) instanceof engine.json.Json.JLong j0\n                        && j0.value() == 1L,\n                \"ASC 缺省 NULLS LAST：首行 = [1]\");\n        t.check(dRows.items.get(1) instanceof engine.json.Json.JArr rr1\n                        && rr1.items.get(0) instanceof engine.json.Json.JNull,\n                \"ASC 缺省 NULLS LAST：次行 = [null]\");\n\n        // 省略 frame：SUM 默认累计帧\n        String noFrame = \"\"\"\n                {\"input\": {\"columns\": [{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"LONG\"}], \"rows\": [[1],[2],[3]]},\n                 \"window\": {\"orderBy\": [{\"column\": \"v\"}],\n                            \"functions\": [{\"type\": \"SUM\", \"outputColumn\": \"s\", \"argument\": \"v\"}]}}\n                \"\"\";\n        String nf = new RequestExecutor().execute(noFrame);\n        t.check(nf.contains(\"6\"), \"省略 frame 时默认累计和出现 6\");\n\n        // ---- 错误请求 ----\n        expectFail(t, \"{\", \"JSON_PARSE_ERROR\", \"残缺 JSON\");\n        expectFail(t, \"[]\", \"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"顶层不是对象\");\n        expectFail(t, \"{}\", \"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"缺少 input\");\n        expectFail(t, \"\"\"\n                {\"input\": {\"columns\": [{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"FLOAT\"}], \"rows\": []},\n                 \"window\": {\"functions\": [{\"type\":\"ROW_NUMBER\",\"outputColumn\":\"rn\"}]}}\n                \"\"\", \"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"不支持的列类型\");\n        expectFail(t, \"\"\"\n                {\"input\": {\"columns\": [{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"LONG\"}], \"rows\": [[\"x\"]]},\n                 \"window\": {\"functions\": [{\"type\":\"ROW_NUMBER\",\"outputColumn\":\"rn\"}]}}\n                \"\"\", \"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"LONG 列收到字符串\");\n        expectFail(t, \"\"\"\n                {\"input\": {\"columns\": [{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"LONG\"}], \"rows\": [[1.5]]},\n                 \"window\": {\"functions\": [{\"type\":\"ROW_NUMBER\",\"outputColumn\":\"rn\"}]}}\n                \"\"\", \"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"LONG 列收到小数\");\n        expectFail(t, \"\"\"\n                {\"input\": {\"columns\": [{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"LONG\"}], \"rows\": [[1],[2]]},\n                 \"window\": {\"functions\": [{\"type\":\"SUM\",\"outputColumn\":\"s\",\"argument\":\"v\",\n                          \"frame\": {\"start\":{\"kind\":\"FOLLOWING\",\"offset\":2},\n                                    \"end\":{\"kind\":\"PRECEDING\",\"offset\":1}}}]}}\n                \"\"\", \"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"非法帧（起点在终点后）\");\n        expectFail(t, \"\"\"\n                {\"input\": {\"columns\": [{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"LONG\"}], \"rows\": [[1],[2]]},\n                 \"window\": {\"functions\": [{\"type\":\"SUM\",\"outputColumn\":\"v\",\"argument\":\"v\"}]}}\n                \"\"\", \"INVALID_REQUEST\", \"输出列重名\");\n\n        // 窗口计算溢出：错误类型为 WINDOW_ERROR\n        String overflow = \"\"\"\n                {\"input\": {\"columns\": [{\"name\":\"v\",\"type\":\"LONG\"}], \"rows\": [[9223372036854775807],[1]]},\n                 \"window\": {\"orderBy\": [{\"column\": \"v\"}],\n                            \"functions\": [{\"type\": \"SUM\", \"outputColumn\": \"s\", \"argument\": \"v\"}]}}\n                \"\"\";\n        RequestExecutor oex = new RequestExecutor();\n        String or = oex.execute(overflow);\n        t.check(oex.lastRequestFailed && oex.lastFailureWasWindowError,\n                \"溢出归类为 WINDOW_ERROR\");\n        t.check(or.contains(\"\\\"type\\\": \\\"WINDOW_ERROR\\\"\"), \"错误响应含 WINDOW_ERROR\");\n        t.check(or.contains(\"溢出\"), \"错误信息说明溢出\");\n\n        // 非溢出失败不应标记为窗口错误\n        RequestExecutor bex = new RequestExecutor();\n        bex.execute(\"{\");\n        t.check(bex.lastRequestFailed && !bex.lastFailureWasWindowError,\n                \"JSON 错误不是窗口错误\");\n\n        return t.report();\n   int bothThrow=0,bothOk=0;\n    // 复刻 DifferentialTest.overflowDifferential 中的循环次数与取数\n    for(int iter=0;iter<120;iter++){\n      int n=1+rnd.nextInt(6);\n      List<Relation.Row> rows=new
